articleTitle: Utilizing Deep Belief Networks for Power System State Estimation and Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The state estimation and anomaly detection of power systems highly rely on accurate and comprehensive real-time data. However, many power systems face data quality issues such as sensor failures, data loss, or noise pollution. Therefore, this study proposes a power system fault detection and recovery time prediction model based on deep belief network (DBN). Firstly, various fault feature extraction methods have been proposed for power system operation data, including electrical quantity features (such as voltage and current), time-domain features (such as power fluctuations, frequency fluctuations, etc.), and normalization methods have been used to preprocess the raw data to eliminate outliers, missing values, and redundant data. Then, deep belief networks are used for pre training of fault features, and unsupervised learning is used to train each layer of restricted Boltzmann machines (RBM) to extract potential features of power system data. This process optimizes the weights by comparing the divergence (CD) algorithm, and further trains the backpropagation algorithm during the fine-tuning stage to improve the accuracy of fault detection. In terms of recovery time prediction, by establishing the relationship between recovery time and fault type, combined with the feature extraction ability of DBN, the recovery time of different fault types can be predicted. The experimental results show that the model exhibits good performance in fault detection and recovery time prediction, which can effectively improve the stability and fault response speed of the power system.

articleTitle: Construction and Experiment Based on the MoE-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper improves the LSTM model in terms of the data compatibility issue due to the deficiency and insufficiency of the data source based on the deep network model, and constructs the LSTM model improved by the Mixture of Experts (MoE) network to identify the types of online learners. The MoE network can minimize the loss function in the multi-model competitive learning, thereby compensating for the drawbacks in the error function during the LSTM modeling process. The LSTM model after the MoE improvement can better handle the parallelized data, has stronger data compatibility processing ability, higher classification and prediction performance, and effectively solves the problem of low robustness of the standard LSTM model.

articleTitle: UAV Intrusion Detection in Hazy Environment Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a small-target UAV intrusion detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv8 in hazy environment is investigated. Aiming at the problem that the traditional YOLOv8 algorithm cannot extract the UAV features in the image under the hazy environment, an improved method based on All-in-One Dehazing Network (AOD-Net) is proposed to give the algorithm a good dehazing ability. The introduction of Deformable Convolutional Networks (DCN) and Deformable Attention (DAT) optimizes the algorithm's ability to capture the local deformation information of the target under the conditions of long distance and high mobility. The algorithm's sensitivity to image core feature extraction is improved, and the efficiency and performance of target detection are enhanced.

articleTitle: Research on the Security Model of IoT Data Intelligent Embedded AI System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a security model of IoT data intelligent embedded AI system based on machine learning. Combining CNN and SVM, this model improves the precision and efficiency of security detection under the Internet of Things. In particular, CNN is used to extract deep features from the mass of data produced by IoT devices, and then input them into the SVM for classification. This paper uses a typical data set in the IoT environment, covering various types such as device behavior, network traffic, and attack data. The experimental results show that the proposed model has a high accuracy rate in security assessment, reaching 92%, which is 15% higher than the traditional rule-based security detection method. In addition, the model shows strong robustness and adaptability in different IoT scenarios, and can effectively deal with various types of security threats. Through comparative analysis with traditional methods, this study verifies the advantages of the model based on the combination of CNN and SVM in processing complex IoT data.

articleTitle: Research on Tax Data Sharing and Privacy Protection Mechanism Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the context of digital reform., tax data sharing and privacy protection have gradually become important issues. With the distributed architecture., tamper proof data., and high transparency of blockchain technology., it demonstrates unique advantages in resolving the contradiction between tax data sharing and personal privacy protection. This article aims to deeply analyze the potential application of blockchain in the field of tax data sharing., evaluate the potential risks of privacy leakage in the current tax data sharing process., explore the conflict between privacy protection measures and data sharing needs., and propose a blockchain based tax data sharing and privacy protection scheme. This plan mainly involves using blockchain technology to ensure the privacy and security of the sharing process., designing efficient smart contracts., establishing a trustworthy mechanism with multi-party participation., and improving the data auditing system., thereby promoting the standardization of tax information processing and privacy protection system. Research has shown that blockchain technology can effectively enhance the transparency and reliability of tax information., while maintaining privacy and security., and promoting efficient information sharing.

articleTitle: A 0.6-4.8 GHz Temperature Stabled Phase-Locked Loop Capable of Operating at 423K
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: An improved phase-locked loop with a wide output frequency range and high-temperature stability is presented to suppress the deterioration of the phase noise and stability under high temperatures. A pre-charged phase frequency detector is used to reduce the area of the layout while increasing the maximum operating frequency. The configurable design of the charge pump ensures stability across various output frequencies. The voltage-controlled oscillator is realized by a multi-band pseudo-differential current-starved ring oscillator, achieving a wide tuning range and low phase noise. This paper implemented by 22nm Fully Depleted Silicon On Insulator process. In the test under 423 K, the measured output frequency ranges from 600 MHz to 4800 MHz. The phase noise is -87.92dBc@1MHz. The total power consumption at 2.4 GHz is 5.739 mW. At room temperature 300 K, the phase noise is -90.25dBc@1MHz. The result shows that this PLL can continuously work when the temperature changes from 300 K up to 423 K, with a decrease of 2.33 dB in phase noise at 1 MHz offset, and it has been verified that the settling time changes from 7us to 7.5 us. This means this PLL has a stable performance across the entire temperature range.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Publishing Mechanism for Real-Time Vehicle Trajectory in Vehicle-to-Grid Networks
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) network is a smart grid technology generated under the background of the rapid development of new energy technology, which allows mobile energy storage vehicles (MESVs) to realize bidirectional energy exchange with the grid system. As distributed energy storage units within the V2G network, MESVs help meet the grid's load-balancing demands. To accurately schedule grid loads, V2G networks rely on MESVs' real-time trajectory data. After collecting this data, the central authority (CA) publishes it to the grid enterprise (GM) for load-balancing decisions. However, before publication, the CA must process the data to protect the location privacy of MESVs and prevent GM from extracting sensitive information. To address this privacy protection challenge during data publication, we propose a differential privacy-based mechanism. Our mechanism uses the unscented Kalman filter to predict and correct the published data at the sampling point and intelligently adjusts the sampling interval. Additionally, we introduce a privacy budget allocation method based on regional access frequency and travel time, enhancing privacy protection of trajectory in high-access areas and peak hours. Through security analysis and experimental validation, our mechanism effectively preserves the privacy of real-time vehicle trajectory data while ensuring data validity.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Multimodal Sensing Technology in Surveying and Mapping Data Collection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative CNN and RNN fusion algorithm to optimize the application of multimodal sensing technology in surveying and mapping data collection. The algorithm combines the data of multiple sensors such as lidar, RGB camera and infrared sensor, uses CNN to extract the spatial features of the image, and uses RNN to analyze the temporal relationship between different modal data, so as to achieve efficient fusion of multimodal data. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm improves the data accuracy by about 18% in multiple surveying and mapping scenarios compared with the traditional single-modal sensor method, and the processing efficiency is improved by 15%. In addition, the algorithm shows significant robustness in complex environments, can effectively cope with the challenges brought by environmental changes, and improves the accuracy and stability of data. The research in this paper provides technical support for the development of intelligent surveying and mapping systems and promotes the popularization of multimodal data fusion algorithms in practical applications.

articleTitle: Lossy Compression of Point Clouds Using Coding Rate Reduction Compressed Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Point cloud compression is a technique that aims to address the challenge of storing and transmitting large-scale 3D data by reducing the size of point cloud data while maintaining sufficient useful information. However, the large amount of data in point clouds and their irregular spatial arrangement complicates storage and transmission. To address this issue, a novel lossy point cloud compression method is proposed in this paper. Our strategy treats point cloud compression as an iterative optimization process, where each layer performs an optimization step to achieve the sparse compression goal. An autoencoder structure is used to enhance the point cloud compression task with coding rate reduction transformer and geometric attribute information. In the encoding phase, a novel self-encoder is used to learn the compressed and sparse representation and geometric features of the point cloud to be used as a compressed embedding of the point cloud. In the decoding stage, point-wise split deconvolution is designed for upsampling the point cloud in order to better reconstruct the point cloud. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves better reconstruction quality and geometry at the same bit rate as other state-of-the-art compression methods.

articleTitle: A Large-Scale Multi-Sensor Dataset for Mapping
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, advancements and applications of computer vision techniques such as neural radiance fields (NeRF) and Gaussian splatting have set new expectations of mapping and 3D reconstruction tasks. Achieving high-accuracy outdoor mapping using radiance field methods requires the integration of robust localization method and carefully designed multi-sensor perception systems. In this paper, we introduce a multimodal dataset tailored for high-precision mapping of large-scale outdoor scenes. To achieve this, we developed an aerial data acquisition platform equipped with a GPS-synchronized solid-state LiDAR, industrial cameras, and inertial measurement units. After comprehensive intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, we collected 3D reconstruction datasets focusing on building exteriors across scenes within a university campus. The raw data, along with documentation on synchronization, calibration procedures, and platform design, will be progressively released on the project's GitHub repository: https://github.com/lilrookie76/radiance-dataset.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Debugging Tool for Power Terminal Equipment Based on Bluetooth Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article explores in depth the design and implementation method of a Bluetooth based power terminal device debugging tool, aiming to significantly improve the convenience and safety of power terminal devices during installation and debugging. In modern power systems, the importance of power terminal equipment as a key component for data monitoring is self-evident. However, due to the complex and variable installation environment of power terminal equipment, as well as the high safety risks, it has brought great challenges to the debugging work. Therefore, this article proposes an innovative solution based on Bluetooth technology, combined with the State Grid 698 protocol as a communication bridge, to build a debugging platform through mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets, realizing remote debugging and on-site maintenance of power terminal equipment. This solution simplifies the debugging process, reduces the operational difficulty of on-site personnel, and significantly improves the personal safety of on-site installation and operation personnel. This plan provides a new solution for the debugging and operation of the power system, which is of great significance for promoting the intelligent and secure development of the power industry.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Research of Multi Channel Acquisition Module
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of signal acquisition technology, the requirements for signal acquisition resolution, sampling rate, and data processing speed are increasing in applications such as radar signals, communication, and intelligent transportation. Therefore, it is urgent to solve how to improve the sampling rate and resolution to meet the current demand for high precision and high sampling rate. This article uses multiple dual channel A/D sampling chips (with a sampling rate of 100MSPS and a resolution of 16 bits), implements synchronous sampling and data transmission based on FPGA, and completes functional and performance verification. The data collected by FPGA can be sent to the processor or upper computer for further data processing and storage through standard network protocols and SRIO protocols. Through practical application in signal processing systems, it has been verified that the multi-channel acquisition module has advantages such as universality and flexible scalability, and has certain application value in engineering applications.

articleTitle: SiP Integrated Design of X-band TR Chip
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a SiP integrated design of X-band phased array TR amplitude-phase multi-function chip and GaAs chip is carried out to achieve the purpose of miniaturization of the chip. In the layout of the substrate chip of the SIP scheme, the design of 1 + 4 structure and 4 layers of substrate stack is adopted, and the heat dissipation scheme is designed and simulated. The RF vertical transition structure and channel isolation circuit are designed and simulated. Finally, the tape-out is completed, and the performance of the transmitting and receiving channels is tested to verify the feasibility of the SiP scheme.

articleTitle: SAR Imaging Based on Range Doppler Algorithm with Phase Coding Signals
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal is widely used in SAR imaging algorithm simulation analysis, however its signal form is too simple, anti-jamming is weak, and a wider bandwidth is often used to improve range resolution, and spectral efficiency is low. Therefore, in modern complex environments that need to balance multiple objectives, it can lead to waste of bandwidth resources. The phase coded signal's good anti-jamming and high signal resolution make up for these shortcomings. In this paper, a range Doppler algorithm imaging simulation analysis method with phase coded signal as echo signal in SAR is proposed. Based on the linear frequency modulation signal, twice four phase coding (QPSK) is carried out to improve the range resolution and anti-jamming of radar. This scheme combines the “randomness” of phase coded signal waveform and is easy to achieve” agility”, which is very helpful for improving the ability of radar system to resist interception.

articleTitle: Research on the Fusion of Autonomous Navigation Algorithms and Environmental Perception in Intelligent Ship Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The research focus of this paper is on the organic combination of autonomous navigation algorithm and environmental perception technology, with the aim of enhancing the autonomous navigation capability of intelligent ships in complex marine environments. Autonomous navigation relies on the close coordination of multiple perception systems and algorithms, among which the simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) algorithm is particularly critical. The SLAM algorithm generates high-precision environmental maps in real time and provides accurate ship positioning by fusing multi-sensor information. This paper proposes and designs an autonomous navigation system that integrates environmental perception and SLAM technology. Its system architecture includes sensor data processing, path planning and control decision modules. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified through a series of model simulations, and experimental evaluation is carried out in multiple test scenarios. The simulation results show that compared with traditional navigation methods, the algorithm significantly improves the navigation accuracy and safety of ships in complex marine environments, and the positioning error rate is reduced by more than 15%. The research results of this paper provide a solid theoretical basis and technical support for the future research and development of autonomous navigation systems for intelligent ships.

articleTitle: Development of the Safeguard Companion for Secondary Safety Measures of Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The correct implementation of secondary safety measures serves as a crucial line of defense for ensuring the safety of power grid maintenance, effectively preventing secondary accidents resulting from personnel misoperations. To better align with contemporary demands, this project delves deeply into four pivotal aspects: digital drawings, cabinet scanning, safety measure card generation, and the rehearsal and verification of safety control sequences. By exploring technologies such as the pre-generation of secondary safety measures based on digital drawings, image acquisition and scanning of cabinets, the development of a secondary safety measures business model, and the comparison of states before and after relay protection operations, we strive to establish an efficient and intelligent system to guarantee relay protection operations, thereby providing robust support for the stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Design of Underwater Renewable Energy WPT System Based on DD-Threaded Pipe Magnetic Coupling Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: AUVs are crucial in marine resource exploration because of their compact size, adaptability, and ability to operate independently. However, as the power source of the AUV, the battery's size, energy density and other factors greatly limit the working endurance time and motion survey range of the AUV. To address this issue, a wireless power transfer (WPT) system with a DD-threaded asymmetrical structure coil is proposed, utilizing a double LCC composite compensation topology to maintain a constant output current on the secondary side. Impedance analysis is used to design a WPT system for wirelessly charging the AUV with the fuel cell onboard the UUV, achieving a 20kW output power. Simulation results verify an efficiency of 93.52%.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of Power System Considering Multiple Inverter Aggregation Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the continuous progress of power system and power electronics technology, multiple power electronic devices play an increasingly important role in power systems. Due to the variety and large number of source-side power electronic devices with different operating principles and control strategies, direct modeling and analysis have become extremely complex. Therefore, this paper addressed the problem of simplifying the model by aggregating multiple power electronic devices on the source side and proposes an aggregated model construction technique based on the multi-inverter single-machine equivalence method, which aims to improve the modeling efficiency of the power system, reduce the difficulty of analysis, and optimize the system performance. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, it has been proven that the method can effectively simplify the model of source-side power electronic devices under certain conditions and improve the modeling accuracy and analysis efficiency to a certain extent.

articleTitle: GNSS Time Synchronization Attack Detection Algorithm Based on Clock Bias Change Covariance
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a GNSS Time Synchronization Attack (TSA) detection algorithm based on clock bias change covariance. By leveraging the synchronization characteristics in the variation patterns of TSA signals, the algorithm effectively detects TSA by calculating the covariance of clock bias changes. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared to the clock drift correlation algorithm, this algorithm not only achieves higher detection sensitivity and accuracy, enabling a clear distinction between normal and TSA signals, but also operates faster, detecting TSA 17.86% earlier on average. Additionally, it reduces computational complexity, saving 17.86% of processing time. This practical detection algorithm is particularly suitable for resource-constrained hardware devices, enhancing the GNSS system's resistance to TSA, ensuring timing accuracy and system stability, and providing reliable security for critical infrastructure.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Induction Heating Litz Coil Based on the Litz Wire Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Litz wire is extensively utilized in the applications of induction heating and wireless power transfer due to its small alternating current (AC) resistance and low loss at high frequency. However, the accurate numerical simulation of Litz wire consumes tremendous computational resources and time owing to its intricate structure of multi-strand twisted in multiple levels, thus posing huge challenges for its design and optimization. To tackle this issue, this study proposes a semi analytical full wave method to highly efficiently simulate the Litz wire. As a demonstration, a planar spiral coil of the induction cooker is simulated and measured. The simulation results demonstrate strong consistency with the measurement, verifying the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed modelling approach.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Deep Learning-Based Image Recognition Algorithm in Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A GAN-based image recognition algorithm is presented to solve these problems. Firstly, the GAN frame is composed of a generator and a discriminator. The generator can produce real images or remove noise by learning the signal image. Then, the image is compared with the real image. In the pre-processing phase, the standard, denotation and enhancement of the signal image are carried out to guarantee the data quality and the validity of the characteristic. Experiments show that the precision of GAN-based image recognition is up to 96.3%, which is more than 15% than traditional methods (e.g., SVM). In the signal denoising task, the model significantly improves the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) by 20% and effectively removes image noise. In addition, GAN also performs extremely well in pattern recognition tasks, with a correct recognition rate of 94.7%. Compared with traditional deep learning algorithms, the GAN model shows stronger robustness when processing signals with more noise or incomplete data.

articleTitle: Carrier Phase Shifting Control Method for Ultra-High Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Digital control technology significantly enhances the performance of amplifiers, directly impacting the operational effectiveness of the system. However, for ultra-high power amplifiers, the interference from ultra-high voltage and current in complex environments presents challenges for precise digital control. To improve the stability and reliability of the system, this paper proposes a carrier phase shift control method for ultra-high power amplifiers. This method effectively mitigates the influence of internal circulating currents and enhances the quality of the system's output signal. Both simulation and experimental results demonstrate the advantages of the proposed control algorithm in improving key performance indicators of the system. Specifically, signal distortion across all spectral segments is kept below 1 %, and the dynamic range reaches 50 dB.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Node Detection Method Using Self-Supervised Learning and Abnormality Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Anomaly node detection in attributed networks aims to identify nodes whose behavior does not conform to the normal pattern, which may indicate potential security threats. For example, anomaly behavior target detection in air combat, where the battlefield situation is described by a graph. Due to the difficulty in obtaining labels, unsupervised methods are often employed, but anomalies are often sparse, which limited the performance of the unsupervised methods. In recent years, graph neural network (GNN) based methods have demonstrated superior performance since their specialty for learning node representations, especially some methods use artificially constructed anomalies. But their performance is limited due to the low performance of the constructed anomalies since the labels of the constructed anomalies may be wrong. To solve these problems, we propose a novel method. Our framework constructs generic anomalies injected to the data serving as prior human knowledge instead of labeled anomalies for training the GNN, enhancing performance through the data augmentation strategy; the structural information of the attributed networks is further integrated into the attribute information through a bilinear transformation, which also enhances the performance. The GNN decoder is trained to reconstruct the network from the nodes' representations, anomalous nodes are detected by comparing the features of the reconstructed graph and the injected anomalous graph. Experiments are done with eight datasets, including four benchmark and four real-world datasets, which show that the proposed framework obviously outperforms the previous anomaly detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Sensor Data Spatiotemporal Synchronization Technology for Onboard Visual Navigation Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Against the backdrop of the rapid development of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology, onboard visual navigation systems have become the core support technology for achieving precise positioning and efficient map construction of UAVs. This paper deeply explores the key technologies of sensor data spatiotemporal synchronization in onboard visual navigation systems, aiming to solve the synchronization issues in multi-sensor data fusion in variable environments, and enhance the navigation accuracy and reliability of UAVs. The research covers both spatial and temporal synchronization dimensions, with a focus on the technical implementation of Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO). For spatial synchronization, a target-based method is proposed to construct an error equation for solving the extrinsic parameters between the camera and the Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), achieving precise alignment of sensor coordinate systems through the identification and matching of visual target feature points. In terms of temporal synchronization, considering the data frequency differences between the camera and IMU, this paper designs a time alignment strategy that realizes efficient temporal alignment of data through data buffering and timestamp matching. Additionally, the initialization and local sliding window optimization process of the Visual-Inertial Odometry are detailed, achieving high-precision fusion of visual and inertial data through feature extraction, optical flow tracking, and motion structure recovery. Experimental results show that the methods proposed in this paper can technically provide strong support for the autonomous flight of UAVs, effectively improving the navigation performance of UAVs in complex environments, and enhancing the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: An Open Interconnection System for Computing Power Based on Service Mesh
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, with the accelerated pace of digitalization, computing power has emerged as a key infrastructure supporting the development of the digital economy and has become a new engine driving economic and social progress. To promote the deep integration of computing power and network resources while providing users with a ubiquitous and consistent computing service experience, the concept of the computing power network has emerged. However, how to meet the requirements of the computing power network for coordinated planning and efficient adaptation of computing and network resources has become a current research focus. Therefore, this paper designs and implements a Service Mesh-based computing power open interconnection system to promote large-scale interconnectivity and network computing integration. The system supports automatic registration, discovery, and updating of computing power services, offering a transparent and efficient invocation mechanism. It features visualization tools for real-time resource monitoring and service interaction.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Detection Vehicle Based on ROS and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This project uses Jetson Nano development board, Internet of Things technology and deep learning algorithm. R & D and application of multifunctional intelligent inspection vehicle series: Class A automatic inspection vehicle, Class B manual inspection vehicle and Class C compact prevention vehicle. Safety research aspects include checking mechanical structure stability and sharp edges, conducting electrical insulation and grounding tests, testing battery protection mechanisms, ensuring sensor fault detection and data accuracy, focusing on software update security and anti-interference, and verifying communication encryption and authentication. Stability and reliability research are gauged through long-term operation for heat dissipation and module performance, repetitive task execution for consistent results, environmental adaptability, hardware durability, software crash recovery, and fault detection.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Unmanned Vehicle System for Efficient Collection of Substation Accident Information
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: We first discussed the latest achievements at home and abroad. The research on the door of protective panel cabinet with interactive mechanical arm is carried out. The study of the interaction between the protection device and the unmanned vehicle is carried out to realize the trip information image acquisition. We made a research on autonomous navigation and dynamic path planning of unmanned vehicles. The technique of fault location based on spectrum and sound spectrum is studied. A set of integrated unmanned vehicle system for substation accident information collection is proposed to realize timely response, real-time extraction and accurate research and judgment of fault information, and improve the level of intelligent operation and inspection of substation.

articleTitle: Constant Voltage Output Control Technique for Wireless Power Transfer System Based on S-S Topology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper addresses the modeling and control of an S-S wireless power transfer (WPT) system in the presence of load variation. The WPT systems can experience output voltage instability due to external or internal system perturbations. To better handle this situation, nonlinear active disturbance rejection control (NLADRC) is suggested to control the dynamic behavior of the system. NLADRC attributes uncertainties, such as the system's unmodeled dynamics and unknown external disturbances, to the total system disturbance and then estimates and compensates for them. In this paper, we construct a transfer function model of a WPT system based on the SS topology, on which we demonstrate the feasibility of the primary-side phase-shift control strategy for application in this system. Next, a first-order NLADRC is designed for closed-loop control of the system output voltage, integrating the system model with NLADRC theory and determining the tuning direction for each component. A prototype WPT device utilizing NLADRC is designed to test the feasibility and performance of the proposed control method. The experimental results highlight the robustness and accuracy of the developed modeling and control strategy.

articleTitle: Design of QV-Band Rotating Joint Apply in Satellite Communication System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The rotating joint is an important part of the mechanical scanning antenna, which ensures the effective transmission of electromagnetic wave signals during the rotation of the antenna. In this paper, the foundational principles and methodologies underpinning the design of a QV-band rotary joint for satellite communication systems are delineated. Furthermore, the electrical characteristics of the rotary joint have been meticulously modeled and simulated utilizing HFSS software. Concurrently, the processing of an actual joint has been undertaken. The test results show that the insertion loss of rotary joint in QV-band is less than 0.4dB and the VSWR is less than 1.4, which meets the technical requirements and the application requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Pig Image Classification Algorithm Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes a pig image classification model based on convolutional neural network (CNN), named Pig Image Recognition Model (PIRM). The model uses regional suggestion network (RPN) to generate candidate regions, and combined with the Faster R-CNN framework, it can automatically extract key information from pig images, such as pig breed, health status and body size. PIRM first extracts image features through a pre-trained backbone network and applies RPN on the feature map to generate candidate regions containing bounding boxes and target probabilities. For each suggested region, the model further categorizes to predict breed and other characteristics of pigs. The loss function of RPN and classification is optimized by combining classification loss with regression loss. In addition, the model is trained using labeled pig image data sets, and the robustness is improved by data enhancement techniques. The experimental results show that the PIRM model effectively combines the object detection and the advanced convolutional network structure to achieve efficient and accurate pig image analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Information Sharing Technology in Distributed Photovoltaic Aggregation Optimization Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper studies the application of information sharing technology in distributed photovoltaic aggregation optimization control, and proposes an optimization control strategy based on distributed gradient descent algorithm. This strategy realizes collaborative control between each substation through information sharing technology to reduce power fluctuations and improve the overall efficiency of photovoltaic power generation. This paper constructs a mathematical model of distributed photovoltaic system and designs a corresponding distributed gradient descent algorithm, which can realize global optimization control under the premise of exchanging only a small amount of information between each substation. The effectiveness of the optimization control strategy is verified by modeling and testing the photovoltaic system data of a certain actual substation. The simulation results show that after applying the distributed gradient descent algorithm, the information sharing between each substation improves the overall power generation efficiency of the system and reduces power fluctuations. Specific data show that without increasing additional hardware costs, the power generation efficiency of the system is increased by about 8% and the power fluctuation is reduced by about 12%. These results fully demonstrate that the proposed distributed photovoltaic optimization control strategy based on information sharing has significant advantages in practical applications.

articleTitle: Construction and Optimization of Key Quality Problem Graph of Power Equipment Based on Association Rule Mining
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the quality management of power equipment, the identification and association analysis of key quality issues are important links to improve equipment reliability. This paper studies a method for constructing and optimizing a graph of key quality issues of power equipment based on association rule mining. First, the historical quality data of power equipment is collected, and the raw data is processed using data cleaning and normalization techniques. Then the Apriori algorithm is used to mine association rules, set minimum support and confidence thresholds, extract high-frequency quality problems and their association rules, and filter out rule sets with significant associations. Then, a quality problem map is constructed based on the mining results, and the quality problems and their correlations are visualized in the form of a network graph. The map structure is optimized through the PageRank algorithm to highlight the key quality problems and their important related items. In a certain power grid equipment failure data set, after the key issues were optimized, the equipment failure rate was as low as 1.6%, providing a scientific basis and optimization direction for power equipment quality management.

Author Keywords: key quality issues of power equipment

articleTitle: Model Free Height Tracking Control for Nonlinear UAVs
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, the trajectory tracking problem for nonlinear UAVs with random data loss is investigated. First, this paper proposes a model-free adaptive trajectory tracking control (MFAC) scheme for UAVs using a data-driven approach that learns directly from the input energy and flight altitude data of the previous moment. The scheme, which is built on the local kinetic linearization technique, introduces pseudo-local differentiation as a time-varying parameter to linearize the UAV. Secondly, a robust time-varying parameter estimation algorithm based on an improved projection algorithm is used considering that the data loss follows a Bernoulli distribution. In addition, a one-step backward compensation strategy is adopted to deal with the communication interruption problem during trajectory tracking. Finally, the optimal parameter values of the MFAC are derived through simulation experiments, which verify the validity and robustness of the model, and also verify the superior effectiveness of the developed way in comparison with other traditional ways.

articleTitle: Feature Mixup with Normalized Logit Knowledge Distillation for Class Incremental Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Class-incremental learning aims to continually acquire new knowledge while retaining previously learned knowledge, mimicking the human learning process. To overcome catastrophic forgetting, various recent approaches based on dynamic-architectures achieve good performance. In this paper, we introduce a Feature Mixup technique when training the expanded model to preserve and strengthen knowledge from old tasks. However, dynamic-architectures bring the problem in memory budget. To address this, we propose the Normalized Logit Knowledge Distillation (NLKD) to control the model size while maintaining performance. We tested our proposed method on three public benchmark datasets, and experimental results show that our approach makes progress.

articleTitle: Research on Configuration Data Generation Algorithm for HyperParser
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The evolution of technologies such as Big Data, Cloud Computing, and Artificial Intelligence is inextricably linked to the transmission of network data. Programmable network devices that facilitate high-speed processing are becoming increasingly crucial. The significance of programmable parsers, as a constituent element of programmable network devices, is readily apparent. HyperParser has the advantages of low latency, high throughput, small area, low power consumption, and full programmability, but its configuration data generation algorithm is inefficient and has limited optimality. In this paper, the inefficiency in running speed is first optimized by subtree partitioning, and the preference for removing certain columns more conducive to approaching the global optimal solution is then analyzed from a probabilistic point of view. Using the big-union, edge network and enterprise network three kinds of parse graph test, the original algorithm in processing big-union in 10min failed to end the run, processing the rest of the two parse graphs consumed 0.1545s, 0.1513s, extracted the number of key bits 7 and 18; the algorithm proposed in this paper processing the three kinds of parse graphs consumed 3.679s, 0.019s and 0.019s, 3.679s, 0.019s and 0.027s, and the number of key bits extracted are 160, 7 and 17 respectively.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on the Combination of Attention Entropy and Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of bearing fault identification, this paper proposes a bearing fault diagnosis method that combines the Improved Refined Composite Multiscale Attention Entropy (IRCMATE) with Bayesian networks. The method uses Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) to decompose the original signal, obtain multiple intrinsic modal functions (IMFs), calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) between each IMF and the original signal, and select the IMFs with PCC greater than 0.3 to reconstruct the signal. Aiming at the problem that the multiscale attention entropy depends on the data length and is easily affected by the outliers in the sample, the improved refined composite multiscale attention entropy is proposed. The paper calculates the IRCMATE of the reconstructed signals, and select the IRCMATE under the appropriate scale as the new feature vector, so as to realize the fault feature extraction of the bearings. Improved Crown Porcupine Optimizer (ICPO) is proposed. ICPO solves the variable conflict problem of Crown Porcupine Optimizer (CPO) by realizing binary conversion through Sigmoid function. The dynamic strategy selection factor is introduced into the CPO, which improves the global exploration ability of the algorithm early in the iteration. After each iteration, the local optimization operations of increasing edge, decreasing edge and reversing edge are implemented on the current global optimal solution, so as to avoid falling into the local optimal solution. Using ICPO to get Bayesian network structure, and the bearing fault diagnosis model is obtained after training using the training set. It is shown through experiments that the fault features extracted using IRCMATE are more obvious. The comparison with other methods shows that IRCMATE-ICPO-BN has a higher fault diagnosis recognition rate.

Author Keywords: improved refined composite multiscale attention entropy

articleTitle: Object Detection Based on Improved CenterNet in UAV Perspectives
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Most current object detection algorithms are based on natural images collected in ideal environments, featuring close-range data acquisition, minimal target scale variation, and predominantly medium-to-large objects with clear contours. However, UAV aerial images present unique challenges for pedestrian detection: Firstly, rapid changes in UAV flight altitude and shooting angles result in large target scale variations, leading to blurred contours and indistinct features; Secondly, the diversity of observation angles causes changes in target shape and features, making it difficult to extract consistent features and increasing the rate of false detections. To address these issues, we propose an improved CenterNet-based method for small object detection from UAV perspectives. We integrate a large-kernel attention mechanism and enhance the Deep Layer Aggregation (DLA) network to improve small object feature extraction. Additionally, we modify the convolutional kernel sampling region to enhance the network's adaptability to shape variations. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed method effectively improves the accuracy of small object detection.

articleTitle: Evaluation of YOLOv8-Based Detection Techniques for Railway Track Anomalies Across Multiple Color Models
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Rail anomalies pose a significant threat to railway safety. However, traditional rail inspection methods often rely on manual visual checks, which are both inefficient and prone to errors, including false positives and missed detection. This study employs YOLOv8 for the detection of rail surface anomalies, and compares different color models to identify the optimal input for enhanced performance. The evaluation of detection results incorporates GEM, TSDR, and SAP metrics, taking into account the specific characteristics of rail anomalies. The experimental results demonstrate that YOLOv8 effectively identifies rail surface defects. Notably, the YCbCr color model emerges as the most effective, yielding GEM results of 0.918 (precision), 0.858 (recall), and 0.921 (mAP), along with a TSDR of 0.918 and an SAP of 0.887.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Image Classification Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: We propose a new model which called MFAAM, specifically designed for image classification. By incorporating multi-scale feature fusion and adaptive attention mechanisms, it enhances both the accuracy and robustness of the classification process. The model's multi-scale feature fusion module extracts feature across various scales, effectively capturing both local details and global patterns within images. Meanwhile, the adaptive attention mechanism dynamically adjusts the significance of different image regions, enabling the model to prioritize key features during analysis. Moreover, this paper also proposes an efficient training strategy that combines data augmentation techniques and mixed precision training methods, further enhancing the generalization ability and training efficiency of the model. Experimental results show that the proposed model achieves outstanding classification performance on multiple standard datasets, demonstrating significant advantages in accuracy over existing image classification algorithms. These innovative designs provide new solutions and technical insights for future image classification tasks.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Research on Time-of-Use Charging Control Strategy of Electric Vehicle Based on Short-Term Historical Load Correction
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Electric vehicles continue to grow on a large scale, and the accompanying disorderly charging of electric vehicles will bring safety risks to the operation of the distribution network. This paper first carried out load correction based on short-term historical load, taking the fluctuation degree of grid load and the minimum charging cost of the user as the objective function, and considered the charging demand of the user and the security constraints of the grid, and then constructed a multi-objective time-of-use charging control model based on short-term historical load correction. Then, multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to solve the charging control scheme. Finally, a practical station area is taken as an example to verify that the control strategy can promote the load absorption of electric vehicles and take into account the operation safety of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Novel Method for FIR Notch Filter Design Using Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Notch filter is an important type of filter which is widely used in communication technology and other fields because it effectively filters out the interference signals with the specific extremely narrow frequency bands, and efficiently transmits signals outside these frequency bands. A novel optimization method for FIR notch filter design using Firefly Algorithm is proposed. This method uses the minimum magnitude error in stopband as the optimization object, uses the magnitude error in passband as the constraint conditions, and realizes the FIR notch filter design by Firefly Algorithm. The result of design has both small order and good performance. Therefore this method can be employed in the FIR notch filter design efficiently.

articleTitle: Intelligent Power Consumption Measurement and Control System Based on C/S and Euclidean Distance
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart grids, intelligent power measurement and control systems have become a key technology for achieving efficient energy management and energy conservation and emission reduction. Traditional measurement and control systems often have problems such as low data processing efficiency and poor real-time performance, which makes it difficult to meet the needs of modern power grids for precise control and intelligent management. In response to the above problems, this paper aims to explore an intelligent electricity measurement and control system based on C/S (Client/Server) architecture and Euclidean distance algorithm to improve data processing efficiency and system real-time performance. This paper elaborates on the application of C/S algorithm and Euclidean distance in intelligent power measurement and control system, including system architecture design, data processing flow and algorithm implementation. Then, through system performance testing and experimental results analysis, the effectiveness and reliability of the proposed system are verified. Finally, the research content, experimental results and shortcomings of this paper are summarized, and directions for future improvement are proposed. The experimental results show that the intelligent electricity measurement and control system based on C/S and Euclidean distance can significantly improve data processing efficiency and system real-time performance. The highest speed of data processing in the system is 200, reducing energy consumption and operating costs, providing strong support for the intelligent management of smart grids.

articleTitle: Modeling of Virtual Power Plants for Photovoltaic-Storage-Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The efficient aggregation of flexibility resources is a crucial technical element for improving the economic performance of new power systems and fostering the development of advanced response strategies on the user side. The decentralized and diverse nature of user-side flexibility resources presents challenges in both the speed and accuracy of aggregation. To address this, this paper develops a model for energy storage, incorporating adjustable characteristics of sources, networks, and loads within the system. A generalized model of three user-side flexibility resources, namely photovoltaic, energy storage, and electric vehicle, is established to portray their operation and regulation characteristics. Building on this, the aggregation method using the Minkowski sum is applied to precisely quantify the regulatory capabilities of multiple flexibility resources, enabling their efficient aggregation. Finally, the proposed method is verified to accurately describe the feasible domain of flexibility resource aggregation through an application case in which the aggregated flexibility resources participate in scheduling decisions.

articleTitle: An Anonymous Communication System Based on Identifier Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Anonymous communication technology has become vital for ensuring privacy in digital networks by concealing the identities of communication participants and the content of their messages. This paper introduces a novel anonymous communication system based on an identifier network, which integrates identity mapping and dynamic IP address substitution to achieve robust anonymity. By leveraging programmable devices like BMv2, this system ensures seamless compatibility with existing network architectures while significantly enhancing communication privacy and resistance to tracing. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that the proposed system effectively conceals the real IP addresses of source and destination hosts, supports high-privacy communication scenarios, and offers strong protection against traffic analysis attacks. The findings suggest promising applications in secure communications and privacy sensitive environments.

articleTitle: Health Status Assessment Method Based on Entropy-Variable Weight TOPSIS Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment for Substation UAV
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In order to ensure the long-term stable operation of substation Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV), a UAV health status assessment method based on the entropy weight-variable weight Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to an Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) fuzzy evaluation is proposed in this paper. By selecting operational evaluation parameters, the ideal positive and negative solution vectors of UAV flight parameters are analyzed and calculated, and the real-time health indicators of UAVs are obtained by calculating the distance of UAV real-time operational parameters to the ideal and anti-ideal solution vectors. Considering that the impact of abnormal individual operational parameters on UAV health status may be obscured by health indicators, variable weight theory is introduced to modify the abnormal indicators, making the assessment results more accurate. Health status levels are established, and the obtained health indicators are mapped to different health status levels, achieving the health status assessment of UAVs at substations. Case study results show that the proposed method intuitively provides the overall health status level of UAVs and is easy to implement in engineering.

articleTitle: Triplet Attention Mechanism-Based Framework for Tower Hard Hat Detection
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Given the poor performance of traditional approaches in identifying small hard hat objects against intricate backgrounds and over long distances, this work proposes a refined TBI-DETR algorithm. The algorithm enhances the model's recognition capability for hard hats by integrating Triplet Attention Mechanisms within the network structure and utilizing a multi-branch architecture to capture cross-dimensional interactive features of the input data. Additionally, a Bi_FPN is constructed to optimize the feature extraction process, promoting effective integration of feature information. Furthermore, a novel Inner-GIoU loss function is developed to refine training efficiency, leading to faster convergence of the model. Evaluation on the SHWD dataset reveals that the proposed approach exceeds state-of-the-art methods by at least 2% in accuracy and 1.4% in mAP@0.5. Its superior detection efficacy offers robust technical solutions for industrial safety management.

articleTitle: Research on Speech Recognition Model Optimization and Real-Time Speech Interaction System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Voice recognition has been widely used in intelligent human-computer interaction, especially in the areas of voice assistant, intelligent house and autonomous driving. Due to the rapid development of deep learning, the precision and applicability of speech recognition have been greatly improved. However, in the complicated noise environment, different accents and high speed of speech, there are some problems in traditional speech recognition systems, such as poor recognition precision and slow response. In order to solve these problems, a novel voice recognition model is proposed, which combines CNN with self-attention. The model uses CNN to extract the local characteristics of voice signals, and then makes use of Transformer's self-attention mechanism to model the long-term dependency of voice data, so as to improve the precision and robustness of voice recognition. Experiments show that the proposed model achieves over 95% recognition accuracy over HMM-based speech data sets, which is 15% higher than the conventional one. Moreover, the proposed model has a good performance in real time speech interaction systems, and it can react rapidly and achieve high efficiency in speech recognition. Compared with the traditional methods, the proposed system is more adaptable in complicated environment, and it can deal with various kinds of background noise, speed difference and accent variation.

articleTitle: UAV-Based Large-Scale Active Mapping with Implicit Neural Representations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Active reconstruction enables robots to autonomously explore scenes, achieving full coverage and alleviating the burden of manual data collection. Existing methods, however, are limited by complex scene representations, particularly in large-scale environments. Implicit neural representations, especially Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF), offer significant advantages for high-fidelity reconstruction of large-scale scenes due to their ability to capture intricate details and optimize storage. In this paper, we propose an implicit neural representation-based framework for large-scale active reconstruction, enhancing NeRF to identify low-quality regions and performing online quality evaluation to guide efficient exploration. We also design an active reconstruction strategy with smooth flight trajectories to improve reconstruction quality and completeness. The quadrotor platform is chosen for its high flexibility. Extensive experiments and ablation studies in simulated environments validate the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: ZSLformer: Zero-Shot Learning for Automatic Modulation Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Deep learning based automatic modulation recognition (DL-AMR) is a crucial component of spectrum management in wireless communication systems. However, most of the existing DL-AMR methods rely on detailed labeled datasets. Additionally, current zero-shot recognition studies in the DL-AMR task are prone to unknown category confusion, which presents a greater challenge in recognizing multiple unknown modulation types simultaneously. In this paper, we propose a novel zero-shot framework, ZSLformer, which optimizes the feature representation for unknown modulation types using self-supervised learning, performs open-set identification based on Extreme Value Theory (EVT), and concludes with unsupervised clustering of unknown modulation types. Experimental results based on the RML2016.10a dataset show that compared to existing methods that suffer from unknown modulation type confusion, ZSLformer is able to achieve an overall unknown types accuracy of 44.73% under four unknown class experimental conditions and demonstrates a more stable performance during threshold adjustment.

articleTitle: Detection of High-Speed Railway Track Bed Foreign Object Based on Contrastive Learning and Adversarial Training
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: High-speed railway safety is compromised by track bed foreign objects, highlighting the imperative for efficient inspection. The track bed foreign objects detection is impeded by the rarity and diversity of those objects, resulting in challenges posed by limited and uncharacterized sample sets. This paper proposes a novel detection method based on contrastive learning and adversarial training, preserving the detection speed of one-stage detection while substantially enhancing accuracy. Contrastive learning sharpens feature discrimination, and adversarial training generates robust samples to bolster model performance. Experiments demonstrate that this approach yields a 12.9% increase in mAP.5 and 9.2% increase in mAP.5:.95, all without additional model parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Abnormal Behavior Detection Algorithm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative algorithm combining GCN and self-attention mechanism for vehicle abnormal behavior detection. The algorithm first uses GCN to construct a graph structure of vehicles and road environments, which can effectively capture the complex spatial relationship between vehicles and between vehicles and road environments, thereby providing richer spatiotemporal features for abnormal behavior detection. Then, a self-attention mechanism is introduced, which is used to adaptively select the key characteristics of the time series data, which can improve the forecasting capability and precision. In this paper, a lot of experiments are carried out on the data set of public transport behavior. The results indicate that the precision of this method is 99%, which is better than the conventional method by 16%. In addition, the proposed model also performs well in F1 value, precision and recall rate, reaching 0.94, 98.2% and 99.1% respectively, showing its high efficiency and reliability in abnormal behavior detection. Compared with the conventional algorithm, this algorithm is more efficient in computation and real time, and the detection delay is less than 150 ms, so it can satisfy the requirement of real time and precision.

articleTitle: Simulation Verification Method for Image Sensor Interface Processing Unit Based on UVM
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Image sensors are widely employed across various industries, including smart mobile devices, autonomous vehicles, and surveillance systems. The Image Sensor Interface Processing Unit is typically characterized by a high degree of complexity to support diverse image sensor interfaces. Consequently, the effective and efficient verification of this unit is essential for upholding project quality and adhering to timelines. This article presents a simulation verification methodology for the Image Sensor Interface Processing Unit utilizing the Universal Verification Methodology (UVM). It explores the features of different sensor interfaces, the architectural framework, core base classes, runtime mechanisms, and reusable components within the UVM verification platform. The study identifies functional verification points based on the specific characteristics and application contexts of the Image Sensor Interface Processing Unit and formulates testing incentives. By analyzing the simulation results, the approach ensures comprehensive coverage of all functional points, achieving a 100% functional coverage rate. The testing platform is systematically designed to provide robust portability while meeting fundamental functional verification requirements, thereby serving as a reference for the development of future module verification environments.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization Scheme for Energy Systems in Distribution Networks Based on Cloud-Edge-Device Collaborative Framework
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: As energy systems evolve, single-system economic optimization no longer meets the growing multi-energy demands of users. To address this problem, this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization method for distribution network energy systems based on cloud-edge-device collaborative (CEDC) architecture. First, a CEDC system for the energy system of the distribution network is constructed in response to energy scheduling requirements, and edge-device clusters are used to achieve distributed management of energy system units. Second, based on the energy scheduling requirements, corresponding energy scheduling commands are generated for the target energy systems. These energy scheduling commands are decomposed into at least one computational task, then the computational tasks are assigned to the edge cluster control units of the corresponding target energy systems. Then, a multi-objective optimization scheme is designed, which jointly minimizes the total power supply cost of a single energy system and the total delay time across multiple energy systems. Finally, the scheme is solved by the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm introducing the simulated annealing. Simulation results show that the proposed algorith can minimize the total energy cost and overall system delay.

articleTitle: Siamese Network for EEG Classification of Motor Execution and Imagery
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Motor imagery (MI), the mental simulation of movement without physical execution, is a pivotal aspect of brain-computer interface (BCI) research, facilitating direct communication between the brain and external devices. Non-invasive BCIs, particularly those utilizing electroencephalogram (EEG) signals, face inherent challenges, including high-dimensional data, temporal dependencies, and variability across subjects. This study investigates the potential of Siamese networks–a deep learning framework grounded in contrastive learning–for single-channel EEG classification in MI tasks. Through a series of comparative experiments employing identical parameter settings, including ten-fold cross-validation, we demonstrate that Siamese networks outperform convolutional neural networks (CNNs), yielding an average classification accuracy of approximately 10% higher. These findings underscore the superior capability of Siamese networks in capturing subtle temporal patterns and mitigating inter-subject variability, positioning them as a promising alternative to traditional CNN-based approaches in EEG-based MI classification.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition of Computer Images Based on GA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Focusing on a field of intelligent computer image recognition, a BP neural network model which is rooted in genetic algorithm (GA) fine-tuning is presented in my study. Aiming at the limitations faced by traditional image recognition methods when dealing with complex image data, we optimise the initial parameters and network structure of the BP neural network using the full-scale search capability of GA, aiming to refine the accuracy and responsiveness of image systems recognition. The experiments are validated using multiple standard image datasets for comparative analysis, and the outcome reveals that the GA-optimised BP neural network model achieves significant performance gains in image classification and recognition tasks. It is proved that the optimised model has faster convergence speed and higher recognition accuracy, which has more obvious application advantages. Ultimately, novel perspectives and methodologies for the advancement of image recognition technology were introduced in this study. Robust theoretical and practical support for the application of GA-BP neural networks in relevant domains were offered.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Magnetic Components in Miniaturized High-Voltage Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This article studied the core loss (iron loss), winding loss (copper loss), and operating frequency of magnetic components in miniaturized high-voltage power supplies. The design of magnetic components was optimized and analyzed mainly through theoretical derivation and simulation. A transformer with an output of 10kV power and 450W miniaturized high-voltage power supply was designed using PC95 material PQ40/40 magnetic core (the transformer outputs four power supplies simultaneously to the spiral line of the traveling wave tube and three step-down collection poles, with a spiral voltage of 10kV). The magnetic component design results meet the power supply requirements. The experimental results validated the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Fire Detection Approach for 10kV Distribution Room Based on Spatial Perception and Hybrid Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Fire is one of the most significant perils in the distribution room. The approach of manually discovering fire through video surveillance fails to respond promptly to fire anomalies in the distribution room. From the perspective of safety inspection of 10kV distribution room and targeting fire anomaly detection, a 10kV distribution room flame detection method based on spatial perception and hybrid attention mechanism is proposed in conjunction with deep learning algorithms. Firstly, a backbone network based on the hybrid attention mechanism is put forward, integrating the hybrid attention mechanism and BiFormer module to simultaneously take into account both the local feature information and global feature information of the flame. Then, a spatial perception feature pyramid network is devised, employing the high-frequency perception module and spatial dependency perception module to enrich the context information of the features of minute targets. Finally, an attention transparent detection head is established to guarantee that higher values contribute more significantly to the overall training and confer importance on the maximum value. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that the proposed method achieves an accuracy rate of 95.6% and a recall rate of 92.5% in detecting 10kV distribution room flames, indicating excellent performance in this regard.

articleTitle: Optimizing Battery Electric Bus Charging Schedules Using Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This research paper presents a novel application of the Simulated Annealing (SA) algorithm to optimize charging schedules for Battery Electric Buses (BEBs), aiming to balance battery health, peak energy consumption, and total energy consumption. The study introduces two SA-based techniques, termed “quick” and “heuristic,” and compares their performance against a benchmark Position Allocation Problem (BPAP) solution and a threshold-based strategy known as the Qin-Modified technique. The SA algorithms employ innovative perturbation methods and charge scheduling heuristics to generate and refine candidate solutions, ensuring they remain within the feasible solution space. Results from a 24-hour scenario involving 35 BEBs and 30 chargers demonstrate that the SA approaches, particularly the quick SA, achieve significant reductions in peak demand and overall energy consumption compared to the BPAP and Qin-Modified strategies. Although the SA methods allowed minor deviations below the minimum State of Charge (SOC) threshold, they prioritized slow charging, highlighting their potential to enhance BEB charging operations while mitigating peak demand costs. This study underscores the effectiveness of SA in solving complex BEB charging problems and offers insights into improving public transport electrification strategies.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Regression Models and Bi-GRU for GNSS Position Time Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate forecasting of the up component in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) time series is crucial for applications in geodesy, structural monitoring, and hazard mitigation. This study compares the performance of several regression models and a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU), an architecture that shares similarities with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks but offers a streamlined structure, in predicting the Up component across ten GNSS stations located in Turkey and Europe. The models assessed include Bayesian Ridge Regression, Huber Regressor, Theil-Sen Regressor, Ridge Regression, Least Angle Regression (LARS), Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) Regression, Gaussian Process Regressor, Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) Regressor, and Random Forest Regressor. The results indicate that regression models like Bayesian Ridge, Huber Regressor, and ARD Regression generally provided more stable and accurate predictions than the Bi-GRU network, delivering reduced RMSE and MAE values alongside enhanced <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">${R^{2}}$</tex> scores. This study demonstrates that simpler, regularized regression models can outperform complex neural networks such as GRU for GNSS time series forecasting, especially when dealing with noisy up component data.

articleTitle: Image Generation with Data Augmentation for Advancing Semantic Segmentation
