publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of semantic segmentation models, the accuracy of semantic segmentation has significantly improved. However, obtaining a large amount of finely annotated data for training requires substantial resources and time. Image generation, leveraging existing semantic annotations, can produce synthetic images that correspond sufficiently and possess high realism and diversity. In this study, we investigate the data augmentation effects of synthetic images on semantic segmentation models and introduce a pioneering approach combining synthetic image generation with traditional data augmentation. Specifically, we apply traditional data augmentation techniques to existing semantic annotations, use the augmented semantic annotations as inputs for image generation, and generate entirely new synthetic images. Through a trained filtering mechanism, we filter out potentially erroneous pixels in the synthetic images, resulting in a usable synthetic dataset. The experimental results reveal substantial enhancements in dataset expansion and accuracy improvement for semantic segmentation models through our approach. For instance, with Mask2Former on the ADE20K dataset, the accuracy increased from 48.7% to 51.2%.

articleTitle: Distributed Intelligent Power Distribution Optimization Method Based on Mean Field Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Mean field game (MFG) theory is an emerging framework designed to simulate interactions among vast numbers of agents, exploring how entities make optimal decisions in a competitive environment. This theory addresses scenarios where traditional game theory becomes impractical due to the vast number of players involved. By constructing a mean field distribution model, we formulate a revenue function for entities within a smart grid system. This function is dynamically programmed to transform the revenue functions into a value function that maps the relationship between the revenues and distribution strategies of smart grid entities across various operational states and time points. Optimal distribution strategies for each entity in the smart grid are derived when both the control equations and mean field evolution equations achieve a Nash equilibrium. Additionally, the convergence properties of mean field games are analyzed, demonstrating that deploying mean field game theory enhances the analysis and optimization of behavior among numerous participants in smart grids. As the number of participants increases, the precision of the mean field game method correspondingly improves. The results indicate that implementing mean field game theory is beneficial for analyzing and optimizing the behaviors of a large number of participants in smart grids. Moreover, the accuracy of mean field games improves with the increase in the number of participants.

articleTitle: Research on an Intelligent Obstacle Detection Algorithm for High Voltage Lines Based on Improved YoLo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent obstacle detection method based on improved YOLO (You Only Look Once) algorithm is proposed to improve the efficiency and safety of automated inspection of high-voltage transmission line corridors in power system. The operating environment of high-voltage lines is complex and changeable, and the existence of obstacles such as kites, nesting birds and hanging foreign objects poses a major threat to the stability and safety of the power system. Traditional manual inspection is not only inefficient, but also faces many security risks. Therefore, it is particularly important to develop an intelligent detection algorithm that can identify and locate obstacles in high voltage lines in real time and accurately. This study first analyzes the limitations of the original YOLO algorithm in the high-voltage line obstacle detection scenario, including the lack of precision for small target detection and the poor robustness against complex background. In order to solve these problems, we propose the following improvement measures: First, the Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) structure is introduced to enhance the detection ability of multi-scale obstacles; The second is to use the deep residual learning framework to solve the problem of gradient disappearance in the deep network training process, and further improve the detection accuracy of the model. The experimental results show that the improved YOLO algorithm has achieved significant improvement in the obstacle detection task of high-voltage lines, and has obvious advantages in Average Precision (AP) index compared with other classical target detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on the Enhanced Target Detection Model of Drone Aerial Images Based on AIGC
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an image enhancement and target detection model based on AI GC (artificial intelligence generated content). The model innovatively combines GAN and self-attention mechanism, and effectively improves the quality of aerial images through processing steps such as super-resolution, denoising and contrast enhancement. The generator performs image enhancement through a deep convolutional network, and the self-attention mechanism focuses on the key areas in the image to restore more details and textures. Experimental results show that compared with traditional image enhancement methods, the AIGC method shows superior performance in different scenarios. Specifically, after AIGC enhancement processing, the mean average precision (mAP) of target detection is improved by 18.5%, the recall rate is improved by 15.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, and the F1-score reaches 90.4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. Furthermore, the results show that the proposed model is effective in complicated background and low light environment, and the PSNR and structure similarity (SSIM) are improved by 12 dB and 0.18. It is proved that the AIGC technique can greatly improve the performance of the VA V, and it is an effective way to solve the problem of the complicated scene.

articleTitle: Abnormal Network Traffic Detection Based on Multi-Pooling Cascaded MPCNN
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Traditional network traffic detection methods based on machine learning have been widely used, but the accuracy of identifying and detecting abnormal traffic is not high. Compared with machine learning methods, deep learning has made significant progress in fields such as text processing, video generation, and other fields, bringing new ideas to abnormal traffic detection. This paper adopts an abnormal traffic classification method based on multi-pooling cascaded convolutional neural network (MPCNN). The accuracy of extensive experiments is 0.9914, the precision is 0.9984, and the F1 score is 0.9962. These experiments achieved the company's goal of accuracy greater than 0.98. It is used for real-time monitoring of daily network traffic to recognize abnormal traffic virtually, alert topic timely, and prevent potential network threats.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Method of Cigarette Appearance Defect Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the development of science and technology, tobacco enterprises use intelligent equipment for production and packaging, and the appearance of cigarette boxes will inevitably have some defects in the packaging process, if not removed, it will affect the image of the enterprise. Therefore, this paper applies deep learning, image processing and other technologies to cigarette appearance defect detection method. Firstly, the image preprocessing and scene classification of cigarette box images were carried out. Secondly, the defect detection methods in the direction of deep learning image processing are analyzed. The defect detection methods based on Faster R-CNN network, YOLOV3 network and YOLOV5 network are respectively tested through experimental data. The results show that the detection accuracy rate of YOLOV5 network is above 99% and the time is shorter. The research of this paper is of great significance and value to the industrial production testing of tobacco enterprises.

articleTitle: Smart Grid Data Security Sharing Based on Cloud-Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid advancement of smart terminals and wireless networks has led to exponential growth in the number of powers of IoT devices and the volume of data. These data resources have become important assets for power enterprises, significantly enhancing the intelligent perception, internal control capabilities, and customer service efficiency of power grids. However, as a national critical infrastructure, electric power data is highly susceptible to cyberattacks, and if leaked, it can pose significant security risks and result in substantial economic losses. Therefore, power enterprises must strengthen data security protection and address security challenges in data exchange, sharing, and mining. This paper proposes a cloud-edge collaborative smart grid data security sharing scheme, which combines zero-knowledge proof technology and a secret sharing scheme to achieve fine-grained access control and privacy protection for user requests. For authenticated legitimate users, a homomorphic encryption algorithm is used to enable secure queries of specific data in the database. Finally, simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the distributed data access authentication and secure query scheme proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Data Anomaly Detection and Early Trajectory Warning Technology
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In complex substation environments, the flight safety problem when unmanned aerial vehicles perform inspection tasks becomes more and more prominent. Currently, the flight control system is the main means of UAV flight status monitoring, but it lacks in-depth analysis of flight data, especially flight trajectory data. To make full use of the flight control system data, this paper proposes an anomaly detection and trajectory prediction method. Firstly, the local temporal features of the original data in the subspace are extracted, and the anomaly detection of the flight data is achieved by measuring the changes of the data subspace vectors on the basis of reducing the computational complexity of the data, followed by dynamically adjusting the thresholds of the anomalous data by using one-class support vector machines. And finally, the UAV trajectory prediction is performed by using a time-series based LSTM neural network, focusing on the anomalies that may affect the safety of flights Data Early Warning.

articleTitle: Method of Tracking Inclined Geosynchronous Orbit Satellite for Satcom on-the-Move Antenna
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The Inclined Geosynchronous Orbit (IGSO) satellite has garnered significant attention for its extensive coverage and high-latitude capabilities. Traditionally, tracking methods rely on Two Line Element (TLE) data for satellite position prediction. To decrease reliance on external TLE data and avoid the complex orbit prediction algorithms, this paper conducts an in-depth analysis of the orbital characteristics of IGSO satellites and the accuracy of TLE-based predictions. A tracking method that employs curve fitting is proposed. Experiment results indicate that the tracking accuracy of this method surpasses 0.1°.

articleTitle: A Novel Roof Detection Algorithm Based SLSC Supervoxel for Airborne LiDAR Point Cloud Data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A new roof detection framework is proposed in this article for detecting roofs from raw point cloud obtained from ALS (Airborne Laser Scanner). There are two main problems solved by the framework, the first problem is that the traditional supervoxel-based algorithm cannot provide accurate feature extraction regions, leading to degradation of classification performance. The second problem is that traditional individual roof segmentation algorithms suffer from the difficulty of ensuring a balance between efficiency and accuracy. To address the first problem, a SLSC (Supervoxel-based Linear Spectral Clustering Segmentation) algorithm is proposed for the feature extraction, which takes into account the correlation of local neighbor changes in terms of supervoxels and provides suitable neighbors for feature computation. Experiments are conducted on two ALS point cloud datasets to evaluate the performance of the algorithms in this article. This algorithm achieved advanced results on two datasets, with overall accuracies of 73.29% and 81.21%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on the Collaborative Mechanism of P4Runtime and SAI in White Box Switches Based on the SONiC System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the advancement of Software-Defined Networking (SDN) technology, network programmability and flexibility have been significantly enhanced. However, effectively integrating traditional network systems with emerging programmable platforms remains a critical research challenge. This paper proposes a fusion architecture based on the P4Runtime protocol to achieve deep integration of SONiC white box switches and the P4 platform. By introducing SDN programmability, we design and implement a hybrid model that enables traditional network architectures to achieve advanced functionalities with the assistance of external SDN controllers. This paper provides a detailed discussion of the architecture design and implementation process, including P4 code development, compilation, target configuration file generation, and interaction mechanisms between the control plane and the data plane. Furthermore, we validate the applicability and performance of the architecture in various scenarios, offering robust support for future research and applications in programmable networks.

articleTitle: Training Neural Networks Based on PSO Algorithm and BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Signal processing has made extensive use of neural networks. This study examines neural network training using the PSO and BP algorithms. To train the neural network, the PSO algorithm alone, the BP algorithm alone, and the PSO algorithm combined with BP algorithm are examined for the same signal. It is determined that the PSO algorithm in conjunction with the BP algorithm can enhance the network's learning efficiency and accelerate its convergence.

articleTitle: Dense Object Detection Method for Remote Sensing Images Based on Improved YOLOv10
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Due to the problems of low detection accuracy and high missed detection rate caused by small and dense objects in remote sensing images, we propose an improved lightweight YOLOv10 model aimed at improving detection performance. Specifically, the standard convolution is replaced with RFAConv in the backbone network to better capture fine-grained object details. Additionally, we incorporate a coordinate attention module to refine the spatial localization and object recognition capabilities of the model. Furthermore, the CARAFE up-sampling operator is adopted in place of standard nearest-neighbor interpolation, expanding the model's receptive field. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved model significantly outperforms the original YOLOv10 on the UCAS-AOD dataset, achieving a mAP50 of 97.2% and a mAP95 of 63.2%. This approach offers an efficient and lightweight solution for object detection in remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Chinese Language Database in Intelligent Communication System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study proposes an innovative Chinese language information extraction algorithm, which combines Bi-LSTM and CRF, aiming to improve the processing accuracy and efficiency of Chinese language in intelligent communication system. Bi-LSTM captures contextual information in sentences through two LSTM networks, forward and reverse, to solve the shortcomings of traditional LSTM in sequence modeling; The CRF makes the optimization of the label sequence output by Bi-LSTM, and the precision of named entity recognition, word segmentation and syntax analysis can be improved greatly. Experimental results show that the accuracy of the system based on this algorithm in the named entity recognition task is 92.4%, which is more than 6% higher than the traditional HMM model. At the same time, the model shows higher robustness and lower error rate in the processing of long texts and complex semantic relationships. On multiple test data sets, the F1 score and recall rate of the algorithm are also greatly improved, and the inference time is kept within the range required for real-time communication.

articleTitle: CAUD-3D: Quantifying Cross-Modal Alignment and Uni-Modal Disentanglement for 3D Understanding via Distribution Similarity Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The lack of suitable evaluation metrics hinders the precise measurement of biases in the cross-modal feature space and the distinctiveness of 3D point cloud features, impeding further optimization efforts for enhanced 3D understanding. To tackle these challenges, we present the unified distribution similarity coefficient driven multimodal pre-training for 3D understanding framework, termed CAUD- 3D, providing a deeper understanding of the cross-modal alignment and uni-modal disentanglement process of the multimodal pre-training. Specifically, we generalize class-wise features to a Gaussian distribution, facilitating the quantification of representation quality within the hyper-sphere space through the calculation of the distribution similarity coefficient. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to measure the representation quality of cross-modal features from the perspective of the distribution similarity coefficient. Furthermore, we formulate the cross-modal class-wise alignment and uni-modal class-wise discrepancy loss terms to align cross-modal class-wise feature distribution and disentangle the interference among the 3D feature class-wise distribution. Our method significantly outperforms previous works.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Print Defect Detection System Based on Machine Vision Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the context of today's digital production, the quality inspection of printed materials has become a key technology to improve printing efficiency and quality of finished products. Especially with the rapid development of the printing industry, the traditional manual inspection method has been difficult to meet the needs of large-scale, high-efficiency production. In order to solve this problem, the automatic inspection system of print defects based on machine vision comes into being, which can not only greatly improve the detection speed and accuracy, but also effectively reduce the labor cost. This paper proposes an efficient defect detection method for printed materials, combining key technologies such as image differencing, binarization, mathematical morphology algorithms, Blob analysis and connectivity analysis to realize automatic identification and classification of minor defects in printed materials. The design and experimental results of the system show that the method has significant advantages in real-time and detection accuracy, and is expected to play an important role in future printing quality control.

articleTitle: Research on the Algorithm of Multi-Threaded Service Monitoring for Automatic Sorting of Work Order Data
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an automatic sorting algorithm for work order data based on multi-threaded service monitoring, aiming to improve the processing efficiency and real-time performance of work order data by optimizing thread scheduling and load balancing strategies. First, this paper analyzes the architecture and challenges of the multi-threaded service monitoring system, and proposes a series of automatic processing methods for deduplication, cleaning and classification of work order data. This paper uses the actual work order data of the power grid operation and maintenance platform. The experimental results show that the system response time is reduced by 38.7% on average and the data processing throughput is increased by 45.2% by using priority scheduling and weighted load balancing algorithms compared with the traditional polling scheduling algorithm. In addition, through the experiment of deduplication and classification of work order data, it is found that the deduplication algorithm based on hash table and timestamp sorting method can increase the data processing speed by 32.4% compared with the traditional sorting algorithm. The multi-threaded service monitoring and work order data sorting method proposed in this paper has significant performance improvement, which can effectively improve the real-time performance and data processing efficiency of the system. This paper provides a new technical solution for large-scale service monitoring and work order management.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm and Simulation Model of On-Board Battery Energy Management
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper proposes an on-board battery energy management optimization algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL). By adjusting the battery charging and discharging strategy in real time, it optimizes energy usage and prolongs battery life. The algorithm models the battery charging and discharging process as a Markov decision process (MDP) and designs an adaptive reward function, which can dynamically optimize battery performance under different driving environments. Experimental simulation results show that the system using this optimization algorithm has significant advantages in energy efficiency, charging cycle and battery life compared with the traditional PID control algorithm. In various driving scenarios such as simulated urban roads and highways, the optimization algorithm improves energy efficiency by 12.6%, reduces charging cycles by 15%, and prolongs battery life by 18%. These experimental results verify the application potential of deep reinforcement learning in on-board battery energy management and demonstrate its advantages and feasibility in practical applications.

articleTitle: Point-Whisper: Boosting Pixel-to-Point via Dimensional Knowledge Uncovery and Efficient Enhancement Tuning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Within the sphere of deep learning, current discourse underscores the relevance of pre-trained expansive models on large-scale datasets. These pre-trained models, distinguished by their extraordinary representational prowess and transferability, have demonstrated notable success in multiple downstream tasks related to natural language processing and 2D vision. However, the adaptation of this pre-trained model to 3D vision presents significant hurdles due to the scarcity and difficulty associated with data collection. To alleviate the issues, we introduce the method, termed as Point-Whisper, leveraging extant 2D knowledge and applying it to the 3D domain. Specifically, we advocate for the use of the Decoupled and Enhancement technique to refine pre-trained image models for point cloud comprehension. We unlock the pre-trained image models' hidden 3D point-friendly knowledge via dimensional information, optimize these masks on the downstream data with the parameters frozen. Additionally, we integrate the LoRA tuning to augment the point cloud-specific knowledge, thereby enhancing the representation of 3D vision. The experiment results indicate that our method substantially boosts performance by a significant margin.

articleTitle: Optimizing Bevy-ECS Using Predictive JSSP Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Entity-Component-System (ECS) is a fundamental architecture of game engines. It consists of entities (identities), components (data), and systems (logical units). It schedules the system graph to drive the update loop. The most popular open-sourced game engine on Github.com, the Bevy engine, is designed in an ECS architecture, and Bevy-ECS is its ECS implementation. While Bevy-ECS is a flexible implementation and easy to expand, performance issues can be found with its original scheduler. The original Bevy-ECS scheduler is based on a greedy algorithm, the system's runtime is unknown to the scheduler, which leads to a poor scheduler in terms of CPU utilization and update loop time. In this paper, we found Bevy-ECS's update loop isomorphic to a traditional NP-Hard job shop scheduling problem (JSSP), then we researched JSSP solutions' approach. With reference to the predictive JSSP solution, we represented a multi-threaded ECS scheduler based on the predictive method in Bevy-ECS. We implement genetic methods for predicting system runtime and use the predicted runtime to schedule the systems. We set up test cases using Bevy-ECS's built-in samples, and then we did performance tests using the profiling tool Tracy. In our performance tests, we use CPU utilization and total runtime to evaluate the performance of the scheduler. The results showed that our optimized scheduler achieved higher CPU utilization and faster update loop time.

articleTitle: Optimization of Harmonic Measuring Device Layout for High-Proportion Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Renewable energy generation power fluctuates with a high degree of randomness. Therefore, to ensure the accuracy of distribution system state estimation, it is urgent to take more consideration of various uncertainties. In order to consider the randomness problems associated with renewable energy grid-connection and minimize the number of harmonic measuring devices, this paper introduces weighting rules and optimizes the position update formula of binary particle swarm optimization algorithm with the help of Levy flight mechanism, and obtains an improved Levy flight binary particle swarm optimization algorithm. Applying this algorithm to solve the layout optimization problem effectively improves the defect that PSO is easy to fall into local optimal. Through the simulation analysis of the improved IEEE-30 and 39-node models, the feasible configuration scheme is obtained. The simulation results show the superiority of the proposed algorithm, which can provide a more suitable configuration scheme for large-scale access of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Model for Predicting the Remaining Driving Range of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurately predicting the remaining driving range of electric vehicles car can help users plan their trips and arrange charging time reasonably, thus improving travel efficiency. In this study, a novel hybrid model combining Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) and Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) is designed. The vehicle driving data of the last 10 minutes is input to predict the remaining mileage of the vehicle online. The vehicle driving data input to the model includes two types of data: monotonic data and dynamic data. The KAN module is used to decompose the function mapping relationship and extract the monotonic data features. The LSTM is used to analyze the time series relationship and extract the dynamic data features. Finally, the features extracted by the two modules are spliced and the remaining mileage is output after weighted fusion. This study assesses the accuracy of model predictions by employing Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and R2 as metrics to compare predicted outcomes with actual values. Compared with using KAN and LSTM alone, the hybrid LSTM-KAN model achieves the best prediction results and can be applied to battery management systems.

articleTitle: Method of Geometric Features Recognition for STEP Files
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Automatic recognition of geometric features formed in design phase is regarded as a primary technical challenge that needs to be addressed in intelligent manufacturing. With the significant increase of the complexity of surface modeling, B-spline curves have been widely used in the design phase, which also add complexity of feature recognition. This paper presents a B-spline curve recognition method that combines curvature decomposition and vector angle decomposition together. By using this method, the geometric characteristics of the curves can be retained while changes in the direction of the curve path can be considered, leading to better curve decomposition results. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed method, a module for automatic recognition of machining geometric features based on STEP files has been developed. Results show that the method enables the direct decomposition of complex B-spline curves and lays the foundation for subsequent intelligent process planning and programming.

articleTitle: Effective Pruning and Compression of CNNs with Exponential Sparsity
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Deep learning models are remarkably accurate and preformat, although they are frequently computationally expensive. Large quantities of memory and high-performance GPUs or TPUs are among the computing resources needed for training and deploying large-scale neural networks. Model optimization becomes indispensable. The process of enhancing deep learning models' effectiveness and efficiency is known as “model optimization.” In this work, the proposed method for optimization is pruning. Pruning has proven to be effective in increasing inference efficiency, decreasing model size, and speeding up training without compromising accuracy. This paper introduces a pruning method leveraging exponential sparsity within each convolutional layer that varies from min_sparsity to max_sparsity and subsequent compression through sparse representations. Secondly, in this approach instead of the entire kernel sliding across the input data, it performs the one-by-one convolution, selecting slices with the important weights in each filter's kernel according to the sparsity target of that convolutional layer and setting all the other slices to zeros. The obtained results from the one-by-one convolution will be summed together to obtain the output map. Finally, the sparse model is converted into a TFLite model which is a converted format that can be used efficiently on edge devices using TensorFlow Lite. A framework that has been developed and evaluated with TensorFlow, leading to a smaller model size, and quicker inference times, and minimal accuracy loss compared to the original models. This study emphasizes the benefits of structured pruning and examines the results obtained with a model based on Vgg16.

articleTitle: LDMOS-Based Doherty Power Amplifier Design in 5G Mobile Micro Base Stations
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A Doherty Power Amplifier (DPA) has been designed and optimized specifically for compact mobile base station deployment, operating within a frequency range of 3.3 GHz to 3.6 GHz. The amplifier utilizes the proprietary DS10-2092 LDMOS transistors developed by the company for both the carrier and peak power amplifiers. Physical test results indicate that the DPA achieves saturated output power meeting the specified requirements, with a maximum saturated drain efficiency of 41%. The drain efficiency remains stable between 26.3% and 30.7% over a 6 dB power back-off range, demonstrating its superior performance in high-efficiency and broadband applications.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection Algorithm Based on Improved BEVFusion
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In fields such as autonomous driving and intelligent transportation, 3D target detection technology is crucial for environment perception and decision making. In this paper, we propose a target detection algorithm based on improved BEVFusion, which utilizes MobileNetV1 and PointN et to extract image and point cloud features, respectively, and combines with a dynamic feature fusion module to achieve deep multimodal fusion. In this paper, the knowledge distillation technique is introduced, and ResNet-101 is used as the teacher network to improve the feature extraction capability and detection accuracy of the student model by passing high-quality feature information to MobileNetV1. On the nuScenes dataset, the detection accuracy of this paper's method reaches 0.724 in the “Car” category, which is higher than 0.554 in PointPillars and 0.548 in BEVFormer; in the “Pedestrian” category, the accuracy is 0.730, which is close to the highest value of 0.732. In addition, the MobileNetV1 in this paper is optimized by knowledge distillation to achieve the nuScenes dataset. Optimized by knowledge distillation, it reaches NDS 0.581 and mAP 0.526, which demonstrates its robustness and practicality in complex scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Encryption with the 2D Cubic Map: A Study of Pseudo-Random Key Stream Generation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the growing demand for information security, image encryption technology has become a crucial tool for protecting data privacy. Traditional Cubic map, due to its simple structure, ease of implementation, and strong chaotic properties, has been widely used in image encryption. However, Cubic map has some limitations, especially within certain ranges of control parameters, where periodic windows can easily occur. This results in a decline in the quality of pseudorandom number generation, thereby compromising the security of the encryption system. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved version of the 2D Cubic map. By introducing cross-coupling terms, the 2D Cubic map significantly enhances the system's nonlinear characteristics and chaotic behavior, expanding its pseudorandomness and increasing the complexity of the key stream. Compared to the traditional Cubic map, the 2D Cubic map is more effective in avoiding periodic windows, thus improving the quality of the pseudorandom key stream. To validate the effectiveness of the 2D Cubic map in practical applications, it is applied to image encryption in this study. Experimental results show that the 2D Cubic map outperforms the traditional Cubic map in image encryption, generating more complex and secure key streams, which effectively enhance the encryption system's resistance to attacks and overall security.

articleTitle: The Difference Analysis of Noise Spectrum Characteristics of Conventional DC Converter Transformer Inside and Outside BOXIN
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Converter transformer is the key core equipment in HVDC transmission system, and the noise it emits is also the most important source of noise contribution in the converter station, and it is of great significance to study its noise spectrum characteristics. Based on the noise recording data measured inside and outside the converter transformer BOXIN in Gusu converter station, the noise spectrum characteristics inside and outside the conventional DC converter transformer BOXIN is analyzed in the paper in detail, and the energy proportion of each frequency band or frequency point is analyzed. Finally, the difference of noise spectrum characteristics inside and outside BOXIN is obtained. The research results of this paper can provide technical support for the noise control of converter station.

articleTitle: Research on Question Answering System of Intelligent Robot Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The preset function modules of intelligent customer service robot question-answering system are usually executed on the basis of the imported question-answering objectives, and the question-answering has deviation, which leads to the stable recall rate. Therefore, the design and research of intelligent customer service robot question-answering system based on deep learning are proposed. According to the current measurement, we access the central processing unit, set up DM368 memory control and voice circuit, and realize the design of system hardware; Combined with deep learning technology, the question-and-answer deviation is controlled, and the question-and-answer function module of customer service robot is designed, and the application connection with dynamic switching database is established to realize the design of system software. The system test shows that: For randomly selected test groups, in the context of 6 time periods, the deep learning intelligent customer service robot Q&A system designed this time has a faster task processing speed and a higher recall rate, which shows that the system itself has strong pertinence and stability, and the Q&A processing efficiency is obviously improved, which has practical application value and innovative significance.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Automatic Testing System for Airborne Acquisition Devices
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper elaborates on the overall architecture of the airborne collector automated test system and the functional designs of its principal modules, such as the control subsystem and the signal source subsystem. It also dissects the pivotal technologies involved in the development of this system, namely test system data modeling, remote actuation of the switch matrix module, aviation integrated bus emulation, test result adjudication, real-time data display, and so forth. The implementation procedures and methodologies are proposed. Eventually, the market and economic advantages of this system are recapitulated.

articleTitle: Single Neuron PID Based ESO for PMSM Control
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A single neuron PID (SNPID) and extended state observer (ESO) is proposed, to address PID parameter optimization and disturbance compensation for PMSM systems. Firstly, it is difficult to determine the optimal values of the PID, a single neuron neural network is proposed to optimize the proportional, integral, and differential parameters, respectively. Secondly, in order to weaken the disturbance of the PMSM system, the ESO is proposed. Then, a composite control method with SN-PID and ESO (SN-PID-ESO) is used to improve the control quality. Finally, transient and steady state performances are verified by comparative simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm of Embedded AI Real-Time Deep Learning Model in IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the optimization algorithm of embedded AI real-time deep learning models in IoT devices, aiming to solve the problem of efficient and low-latency inference in resource-constrained environments. In order to solve the problems of high computational complexity and large memory occupation of existing models when running on embedded devices, this paper proposes a multi-stage optimization framework, which combines model compression, quantization and acceleration techniques to significantly improve the real-time performance of the model. We have introduced a structured pruning approach that reduces the amount of model parameters and computational overhead by removing redundant neurons and channels. Secondly, converting the floating-point number into a low-bit integer representation, which further reduces the memory occupation and computational complexity. In addition, an adaptive inference scheduling algorithm was designed to dynamically adjust the inference path according to the characteristics of the input data, which improved the response speed and energy efficiency ratio of the model. The optimized model in this paper achieves more than 50% improvement in inference speed in multiple IoT application scenarios, while maintaining a high accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Different PSKs in Deep Space Communication
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the current development of deep space communication and analyses the difficulties in signal transmission in deep space communication. Then, based on these difficulties, different signal modulation methods are analyzed theoretically. The theoretical modulation performance of different PSK is compared, and the simulation of the actual communication environment and the signal transmission performance comparison are completed via MATLAB. Finally, based on the analysis of simulation results, it is concluded that QPSK is the most appropriate signal modulation mode for deep space communication.

articleTitle: Research on Dialogue State Tracking Method Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: A task-based dialogue system is a system that automatically provides services or solves problems through dialogue based on the user's task requirements. In recent years, with the continuous development and popularity of artificial intelligence technology, task-based dialogue systems have received more and more attention, but there are still some unresolved problems. An LSTM-based dialogue state tracking model is proposed to solve the problems of insufficient integration of dialogue history and current dialogue and lack of semantic representation of semantic slots. The slot names are replaced with corresponding semantic information, which is described by the interpretation of the corresponding words. The encoding vectors of each pair of conversation history and current conversation are interacted with slot interpretation separately, and the conversation history is fully integrated into the current conversation using LSTM. The method fully considers the specific meanings of slot names and strengthens the influence of dialogue history and current dialogue on the current semantic slot. It can effectively solve the problem that words with short semantic slots cannot fully express the semantics.

articleTitle: Direction-of-Arrival Estimation with Arbitrary Linear Array: A Turbo-HS Approach
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Conventional subspace-based direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation algorithms require optimal environments to achieve satisfactory estimation accuracy. With the advancement of sparse signal recovery theory, sparse optimization-based DOA estimation algorithms have exhibited commendable performance. One of the popular sparse optimization method is sparse Bayesian learning (SBL), due to the fact that it does not require regularization parameters. However, existing SBL algorithms do not adequately address the issue of noise modeling. In order to more accurately model the received signal covariance matrix under finite snapshots, we transform the signal covariance matrix into the form of sparse representation, normalize the variance of the observation matrix and vectorize it. Based on this, we introduce the Turbo-CS framework, which divides the DOA estimation problem into two subproblems: LMMSE estimation for external noise separation and a novel prior for internal SBL DOA estimation. As demonstrated by the experimental results, the proposed algorithm performs optimally in a variety of scenarios.

articleTitle: Gesture Recognition-Based Robot Arm Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Robot arms are widely applied in various fields of human-computer interaction. Most mature robot arm products rely on sensors for control, leading to high costs and strong dependency on hardware. This paper uses gesture recognition to control the movement of a robot arm. It employs the D-H method for robot arm modeling, utilizes a camera to capture gesture information, and transmits image data via a USB interface. The Baidu Qianfan large model API is invoked through a wireless network card to achieve gesture recognition results. During the control process, the trajectory of the robot arm is recorded in real-time, enabling teaching functionality for the robot arm. This system can complete the control of the robot arm by gestures.

articleTitle: A Low-Power Clustering Routing Protocol Optimization Scheme for Substation WAPI
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study centers on the substation application scenario and offers an optimized solution for the low-power LEACH protocol used in substation WAPI. The algorithm put forward herein comprehensively considers the current remaining energy of nodes as well as the node distribution location. By bringing in the remaining energy factor and the distance factor, it optimizes the formula for the cluster-head election threshold. This optimization makes the cluster-head election more scientific and the energy consumption distribution more uniform. Furthermore, the simulation results show that compared with the traditional LEACH algorithm, the EHN-LEACH algorithm proposed in this paper can further reduce the network energy consumption and prolong the network usage time.

articleTitle: Identification and Localization Method of Defect Points in High-Voltage Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: During the installation of transmission lines the wire installation quality robot is equipped with an intelligent system that automatically checks the installation quality of the wires. The paper proposes a new wire defect detection scheme based on image recognition, and presents the structure and optical scheme of a wire installation quality robot. Based on the description of the types and characteristics of typical wire defects, a defect marker image recognition method based on scale invariant feature transformation algorithm is proposed. Firstly, we need to determine the texture features of normal wires, and based on this, identify the given defect markers. Actual experimental testing was conducted on the algorithm, and it was determined that the defect marking algorithm met the expected requirements, with indicators such as missed detection rate, misjudgment rate, and accuracy achieving the expected level.

articleTitle: Design of Monitoring and Early Warning System for Abnormal Status of Water Turbine Equipment
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The trend and demand background of intelligent and digital development of pumped storage power stations have put forward higher requirements for the operation monitoring and fault warning of water turbine units. This article first analyzes the data monitoring requirements of water turbine units in pumped storage power stations and proposes strategies for warning design. Furthermore, the technical advantages of various measuring devices were compared at the hardware level. Subsequently, a comprehensive early warning system architecture for monitoring the status of water turbine equipment was proposed at the software level. Finally, a framework for comprehensive monitoring and early warning system of water turbine equipment status was constructed, and its functional requirements were clarified, providing corresponding technical routes for the intelligent construction of actual pumped storage power stations.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Algorithm of Automobile Low Beam Feature Points Based on Point Symmetry Degree
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Accurate detection of the feature points of automobile low beam is a crucial step in the alignment and adjustment of automobile low beam headlights. Its detection accuracy plays a decisive role in the accuracy and reliability of the comprehensive detection results of automotive headlamps. Moreover, it is an important technical support for ensuring the safety and compliance of vehicle lighting systems. However, the existing detection algorithms for low beam feature points cannot generally and effectively detect and distinguish the feature points of low beam with different low beam light patterns. Therefore, this paper proposes a new detection algorithm for the feature points of automotive low beam light patterns based on point symmetry degree. The core of this algorithm lies in making full use of the significant difference in point symmetry degree between corner points and non-corner points, and realizing the precise detection of low beam feature points based on this feature. The experimental results show that this algorithm can accurately identify and distinguish the elbow points and other feature points in the currently common “two-segment” and “five-segment” low beam light patterns. It has high detection accuracy, demonstrates strong universality and robustness, can effectively resist various interference factors, and has broad application prospects in the fields of automobile headlight optical detection and alignment adjustment.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Model for Lip Reading
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Lip Reading is recognizing speech from visual information alone, which has become a critical technology for improving speech recognition in noisy environments or for individuals with hearing impairments. Traditional lipreading methods typically rely on handcrafted features or shallow models, which fail to capture the rich spatiotemporal dependencies inherent in visual speech, leading to high recognition error rates. In this paper, we propose a novel deep learning framework, LRnet, which combines 3D convolution and ResNet-18 for feature extraction, employs a Conformer encoder to handle sequential information, and jointly trains with a Transformer decoder using CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) loss and cross-entropy (CE) loss to enhance lipreading accuracy. We conduct extensive experiments on the public LRW-1000 dataset, and the results show that our model outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in the lipreading task.

articleTitle: Load Estimation for Transformers Based on Acoustic Features
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach for estimating the load of transformers by analyzing the radiated acoustic signals emitted by the transformers. The methodology involves the development of load-correlated acoustic features based on the principles governing the acoustic emissions of transformers. Through the collection and analysis of operational data from a traction substation, a predictive model correlating transformer acoustic signals to load is formulated using machine learning algorithms. The experimental findings demonstrate that this technique can accurately estimate transformer load utilizing solely the acoustic emissions from transformers, eliminating the need for electrical data after a brief period of data training. Consequently, this method holds promise as an innovative auxiliary tool for monitoring purposes.

articleTitle: An Efficient Dense Pedestrian Detection Model Based on RT-DETR
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is a vital study field within object detection. With the development of deep learning, models perform exceptionally well in pedestrian detection for sparse scenarios. However, their performance often fails in complex and crowded dense pedestrian scenarios, particularly when there is a concentration of small objects. Challenges such as low detection accuracy, high miss rates, and high false-positive rates persist in these scenarios. To enhance dense pedestrian detection performance, we propose a model named RT-DETR-LKG, based on RT-DETR. The improved model incorporates LSKA (Large Separable Kernel Attention) and the GELAN (Generalized Efficient Layer Aggregation Network) modules (LKG). The backbone network integrates the LSKA, which generates spatial attention weights for feature maps via multiple convolutional layers. This process enables feature extraction across various receptive fields and applies weighting to input channels, resulting in more refined feature extraction and enhancement. The hybrid encoder network applies the GENLAN module. It achieves rich feature extraction with minimal computational cost by combining channel partitioning and repeated convolutions. The network's feature extraction ability is also kept. In bounding box regression, the WIoU loss function is used instead of the GIoU loss function to improve anchor selection for occluded and small object prediction boxes. Experimental results indicate that the new RT-DETR algorithm performs better in crowded pedestrian scenarios. It has a mean average precision of 86.1%, which is 1.2% higher than the original model.

articleTitle: Research on the Quality Model System of Virtual Scene Image Generation Based on Progressive Tower Structure Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In the field of virtual scene image generation, Progressive Growing of GAN (PGGAN) has attracted much attention because of its ability to generate high resolution and high quality images. However, PGGAN still suffers from missing details and inconsistent generation when generating complex scenes. In this paper, a new method, spatial-Progressive Growing Attention (SPGA), is proposed to combine the Progressive algorithm of tower structure with Spatial Attention mechanism. By incorporating a spatial attention mechanism, SPGA elevates its focus on crucial image areas, thereby enhancing the quality and coherence of the generated image's details. In particular, the SPGA approach employs spatial attention modules at every stage of generation, dynamically modulating the significance weights assigned to diverse regions. This enables the model to allocate greater attention to vital details during the generation process. Finally, through the comparison experiment and analysis of the proposed framework with the traditional optimization algorithm, the experimental results show that the SPGA method has significant advantages in improving the quality, detail richness and robustness of the generated images. Especially in the task of generating complex virtual scenes, the SPGA method can capture and generate key details more accurately and reduce artifacts and unnatural phenomena. This framework proves the reliability and effectiveness of the virtual scene image generation quality model system.

articleTitle: Securing Distributed Power Dispatching Systems: A Framework for Cybersecurity and 5G Integration
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the increasing integration of distributed energy resources (DERs) into power grids, the security of distributed power dispatching control systems becomes a critical concern. This paper presents a comprehensive security framework to address the unique challenges posed by these systems. The study focuses on four key areas: (1) security partitioning strategies, (2) layered network security defense architecture, (3) 5G-based secure communication for distributed power dispatching systems, and (4) security monitoring and emergency response technologies. The proposed solutions aim to mitigate cyber threats and enhance the resilience of distributed power dispatching control systems in modern power grids.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Cluster Lighting System for Tethered UAVs
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In practical applications, traditional tethered lighting Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are constrained by external factors such as the number of UAVs, the individual ability of the flyer and the on-site scheduling situation, so that their service quality is difficult to be ensured in complex scenarios such as emergency rescue and other emergency situations where the number of users is large, the distribution is wide, and the demand changes rapidly. And there is an urgent need to make intelligent improvements to their deployment methods. Aiming at such problems, this paper designs a tethered UAV cluster intelligent lighting system. The goal of this system is to autonomously receive the user's lighting requirements and calculate the optimal number and location of UAV deployment using algorithms such as simulated annealing, thus assisting the flyer to efficiently complete the UAV deployment task. Test results show that the system can accurately find the optimal deployment plan for UAVs and provide users with high-quality lighting services.

articleTitle: Real-Time Object Tracking Algorithm Based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, we delve into real-time object tracking algorithms grounded on the attention mechanism. Moreover, we present an innovative spatio-temporal attention mechanism (PRO-AM) to enhance the performance of extant algorithms. In the experiment, the large-scale dataset GOT-10K was employed, and a series of ablation experiments were designed to evaluate the influence of different configurations on the performance of the algorithm. The results suggest that the integration of the temporal attention module and the spatial attention module significantly enhances the algorithm's accuracy and robustness in complex environments. The temporal attention module enables the model to better comprehend the temporal information of the target, whereas the spatial attention module effectively subdues the background noise and accentuates the target area. Additionally, the experimental results demonstrate that the appropriate quantity of dynamic templates and update interval settings can yield the optimal tracking effect. This not only sustains the real-time performance of the algorithm but also elevates the tracking accuracy. This research offers novel ideas and technical backing for the realm of real-time object tracking, thereby facilitating the further advancement of this field.

articleTitle: Forest Fire Prevention and Detection System
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Forest fires pose significant threats to both the environment and human life, necessitating the development of advanced detection and prevention systems. In this study, we propose an integrated IoT (Internet of Things)-based system for early detection and management of forest fires. The system incorporates a range of sensors including heat, gas, and thermal imaging sensors, along with IoT technology for real-time monitoring and communication. Utilizing image processing techniques and (ML) Machine Learning algorithms, the system can accurately detect fires, predict their spreading patterns, and analyze environmental conditions. Key features include the deployment of disposable heat sensors for temperature monitoring, IoT sensors for gas detection and weather monitoring, and a centralized processing node for data analysis. Alerts are sent to nearby authorities and residents, while automated firefighting devices are activated to suppress fires until backup arrives. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed system in early detection and prevention of forest fires.

articleTitle: Research on Redundant Traffic Scheduling in Time-Sensitive Networking
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In traffic transmission, failures of links or devices can reduce the traffic reception rate, thus impacting the network's reliability. The IEEE 802.1CB Frame Replication and Elimination for Reliability (FRER) protocol is a standard in Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) that increases network fault tolerance by transmitting traffic through backup paths. In scenarios with mixed traffic transmission, it may be necessary to combine FRER with traffic shaping mechanisms to simultaneously meet the requirements of high reliability and low latency for high-priority traffic. However, there is currently limited research on the combination of FRER and traffic shaping mechanisms. To address this issue, this paper investigates the impact of combining FRER with Time-Aware Shaping (TAS) and Credit-Based Shaping (CBS) on traffic forwarding, using the OMNeT++ platform for simulation experiments. The simulation results show that, at the traffic forwarding layer, the impact of the FRER mechanism on the TAS mechanism mainly lies in the potential inability of traffic to pass through its original time slot, whereas the impact on the CBS mechanism could result in traffic congestion. Based on the potential issues, simple solutions are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Low Frequency Stability of Photovoltaic Connected High Speed Traction Power Supply System in Light Load Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Low-frequency oscillations are a common issue in traction power supply systems, and the integration of photovoltaic (PV) systems exacerbates the coupling and nonlinearity within these systems, leading to a complex photovoltaic-train-network coupled system that increases the likelihood of electrical parameter mismatches. This paper investigates the low-frequency stability of the system during the photovoltaic integration process under light-load conditions in a single-arm traction power system. The study first analyzes the topology and operational principles of integrating photovoltaic systems into the traction power supply system via a back-to-back inverter. Small-signal modeling techniques are then employed to derive the mathematical models of the photovoltaic system, the back-to-back inverter, and the train-network system. Based on the source-load relationship and the equivalent impedances of each subsystem, the coupling matrix of the photovoltaic-train-network system is established. The low-frequency stability of the system under the light-load scenario is analyzed, and the effects of various control strategies of the photovoltaic system on system stability are assessed using the extended forbidden zone criterion. Finally, the effectiveness of the stability analysis is verified through StarSim HIL semi-physical testing.

articleTitle: Study on Discharge Acoustic Features of UHV and EHV Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This study proposes a novel acoustic feature as an indicator for partial discharges (PD) activity by exploring the acoustic signal generation mechanisms and characteristics of PD in power equipment. Firstly, a dataset was collected from various ultra-high-voltage (UHV) and extra-high-voltage (EHV) power equipment, including 1000 kV transformers and reactors, and 330 kV transformers. Then, a correlation analysis was conducted between discharge acoustic features (DAFs) and oildissolved gas (ODG) parameters. The results demonstrate a strong correlation between the DAFs and ODG parameters in the tested equipment, indicating that the DAFs can effectively indicate the discharge activity of power equipment, and validating the effectiveness and general applicability of DAFs for condition monitoring of UHV and EHV power equipment.

articleTitle: Application of Multilayer Cascade Fusion Enhanced Network Model (MLCF-Net) to Underwater Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, a multilayer cascade fusion enhancement network model (MLCF-Net) is proposed with the aim of improving the quality of underwater images. Firstly, by classifying the degradation phenomena of underwater images, the study analyzes the causes of bias, blur and low light, and quantifies the characteristics of different degraded images using texture-aware joint color histogram analysis. Based on this, for each degradation case, this paper designs corresponding enhancement strategies: using white balance correction technique to resolve the off-color, Laplace filtering with deep learning super-resolution model to recover blurring details, and using adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE) to enhance low-light images. Finally, MLCF-Net effectively copes with the coexistence of multiple degradation phenomena in complex scenes through three modules-color correction, texture enhancement, and luminance compensation-combined with a cascade fusion strategy.

articleTitle: The Application of Deep Learning Method Combined with Attention Mechanism in Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: In this paper, we explore the application of a deep learning approach integrated with an attention mechanism for text classification, aiming to enhance the performance and robustness of complex text classification tasks. Addressing the limitations of traditional text classification methods in capturing contextual dependencies, handling long texts, and dealing with semantic ambiguity, we propose an innovative model that leverages deep learning architectures combined with a self-attention mechanism to improve feature extraction by dynamically focusing on key information within the text. The model employs word embeddings and a hierarchical network structure, with a multi-head attention mechanism at its core. Additionally, the model is optimized for specific task objectives to achieve efficient multi-class text classification. Experimental results on multiple publicly available datasets show that the proposed method achieves superior performance compared to existing state-of-the-art approaches, particularly in terms of accuracy and F1 score. This is especially evident when handling long and complex text data, where the model demonstrates enhanced capability in capturing relevant features and improving classification accuracy. Furthermore, a visual analysis of the attention weight distribution is conducted, offering insights into the model's text feature extraction mechanism. These findings provide valuable theoretical contributions and practical guidance for advancing text classification techniques in the field of natural language processing.

articleTitle: Research on Abnormal Behavior Recognition Algorithm of Intelligent Ship Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper undertakes an exhaustive examination of real-time recognition and detection of abnormal ship behavior. Taking YOLOv5 as the foundation model, an enhanced approach rooted in YOLOv5 is introduced through comparative analysis with prevailing target detection models. In this study, the optimization was carried out from the level of network structure, including the design of lightweight model structure, the introduction of attention mechanism module, and an oversampling data enhancement method with scale transformation (S-mosaic) to improve the robustness of the model. Multiple experimental comparisons have markedly enhanced the model's accuracy. The findings demonstrate that the suggested refined model excels in identifying abnormal ship behaviors, thereby offering substantial technical assistance for safety monitoring in intelligent ships.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Rolling Bearing Based on PE-VMD-CNN
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Variational mode decomposition (VMD) often has the problem of over-decomposition or under-decomposition in the analysis of bearing signals, which leads to a lot of invalid information in the signal, and the permutation entropy (PE) algorithm can measure the time series complexity and randomness of the signal. In order to solve the above problems, a fault diagnosis method using PE optimized VMD fused with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) is proposed. First, considering computational complexity and the degree of feature information inclusion, the number range of mode decomposition for VMD is set to be [2, 6]. The VMD then performs the first decomposition of the signal, calculates the permutation entropy of each mode component, and automatically determines the best mode component K value. The VMD then performs a second decomposition of the signal using the best K value to obtain representative mode components and reconstruct them into eigenvectors. Finally, feature vectors are input into CNN for fault classification. The method was verified on Case Western Reserve University datasets with a fault identification accuracy of up to 99 %, and compared with EMD-CNN, EEMD-CNN, EMD-LSTM, EEMD-LSTM, and PE-VMD-LSTM diagnostic methods, the PE-VMD-CNN based method has the highest accuracy, F1 score, accuracy, and recall among four evaluation indicators.

articleTitle: Research on Image Data Classification Algorithms Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: This paper presents an image data classification algorithm based on deep learning. By integrating a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the ResNet-50 backbone, we form an enhanced attention residual module and validate it on the CUB-200-2011 dataset. Transfer learning is employed using ImageNet pre-trained weights, with images uniformly resized and randomly cropped to ensure consistent input. Training utilizes a stochastic gradient descent (SGD) optimizer, combined with a cosine annealing strategy for dynamic learning rate adjustment, and incorporates data augmentation techniques such as random flipping and color jitter to improve model generalization. The findings from the experiments show that the model markedly improves the effectiveness of classification. It accurately locates key areas in complex backgrounds and effectively captures local detailed features, thereby improving the learning of important features and reducing background noise interference. Ablation studies show that introducing the attention mechanism significantly boosts model accuracy, while combining channel grouping attention further enhances semantic feature learning. These findings highlight the proposed method's superiority in finegrained image classification tasks.

articleTitle: Performance of Spam Detection Models for Complex Data: Integrative and Hybrid Approaches
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, spam poses significant challenges, affecting information transmission and security. This paper addresses spam detection through a combined integrated and hybrid model approach, enhancing classification performance using multiple learners. By integrating a probability-corrected Support Vector Machine (SVM) with an optimized lightweight gradient Elevator (Light- GBM), the model's robustness is improved. TF-IDF was employed for text feature extraction and adversarial sample generation. Experimental results indicate that the Light-SVM integrated model achieves 99.39% accuracy and a 97.68<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>F1 score, while the hybrid model LSmix attains 98.21 % accuracy and a 92.82% F1 score, demonstrating excellent detection effectiveness, stability, and capability in handling complex data and adversarial samples.

articleTitle: Dugdale-GAN: Physical Dugdale Model Integrated Generative Adversarial Network for High-quality Crack Image Generation
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Vision-based crack detection systems face significant challenges in training data scarcity and imbalance. While Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) offer potential solutions, existing methods often generate physically implausible patterns. We propose Dugdale-GAN, a novel framework that integrates the physical Dugdale model with GANs to generate realistic crack patterns. Our approach incorporates material-specific parameters and features a dual-generator and dual-discriminator architecture to ensure both physical consistency and visual quality. We also introduce the Diversity Quality Indicator (DQI), a comprehensive metric for evaluating both image quality and pattern diversity. Experimental results demonstrate that Dugdale-GAN outperforms existing methods in generating physically plausible crack patterns.

articleTitle: A novel feature extraction method of wood borer larvae acoustic spectrograms based on bidirectional Mel filtering and its application in lightweight network
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: The larvae of wood borers possess a high degree of concealment, posing significant challenges for their early and accurate detection. In this paper, taking the sound of red palm weevil larvae activities as the research object, a preferred feature extraction method based on the short-time Fourier transform acoustic spectrogram bi-directional Mel filtering algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the short-time Fourier transform acoustic spectrogram of the original audio signal is extracted, and after comparing the recognition effects in different frequency bands in a variety of typical convolutional neural networks, it is determined that the effective audio features are mainly concentrated in the high and low frequency domains side of the acoustic spectrogram. The bidirectional Mel filter banks are designed to reduce the noise in the middle frequency band, and the logarithm and chroma of the spectrogram are preferably determined as the best fusion objects to splice the preferred spectrograms of different time frames in the frequency domain, and finally form the target features that can be used for early detection. The results show that compared with the latest short-time Fourier transform method[1], the use of this feature can improve the average accuracy by 1.5%, and has better universality, with the average accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 value reaching 0.9591, 0.9475, 0.9558, and 0.9512, respectively, which, together with the use of a lightweight model LRPWN, can meet the needs of early and precise detection (96.30% accuracy, 94.92% precision, 96.37% recall, and 95.60% F1 score, 7.68K parameters and 4.85M float computations. Compared with the lightweight model mobile_v3 with the highest accuracy in our experiments, LRPWN's accuracy is only 0.04% lower, while the number of parameters and the amount of calculation are reduced by 97.80% and 73.67% respectively.

articleTitle: Real-Time MDNet with Adaptive Feature Fusion for RGB-T Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
abstract: Given a video and its initial target, visual object tracking aims to locate the specific target in the following frames. Most trackers only utilize visible modality, leading to inferior performance on dark night. Current researchers have tried to involve thermal data to achieve satisfying performance in all conditions. The main issue on RGB-T object tracking is how to fuse those modalities. In this paper, we propose a real-time MDNet with adaptive feature fusion method. We introduce information entropy to obtain fusion weights, which can achieve adaptive fusion. Our method can achieve better performance on the public dataset against several fusion methods. Both quantitative and qualitative experiments validate the effectiveness of our method. Furthermore, our method can maintain real-time speed.

articleTitle: Graph Neural Network Algorithm Based on Graph Convolution and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 IEEE 5th International Conference on Power, Electronics and Computer Applications (ICPECA)
